Its API abstracts private key generation, signing and policy enforcement into secure, scalable enclaves, letting apps spin up millions of non-custodial wallets with flexible permissions, social recovery and session keys. Used by exchanges, fintechs and on-chain games, Turnkey emphasizes sub-100ms signing, audited cryptography and fine-grained policies without exposing raw keys. Backed by leading investors including Sequoia and Variant, the company focuses on invisible infrastructure that makes crypto UX feel like Web2. Headquartered in New York with a remote US team, Turnkey operates with deep security expertise. Expect a high-trust engineering culture focused on key management rigor, developer experience and reliable operations.

figure.name: Figure
figure.description: Figure, founded in 2018 by Mike Cagney and June Ou in San Francisco, builds blockchain-native lending and capital markets infrastructure on the Provenance Blockchain. Its flagship products include Figure HELOCs, mortgage and marketplace lending with on-chain securitization that shortens settlement from weeks to days. Having originated substantial home equity and loan volume, Figure pairs consumer fintech distribution with institutional funding rails. The company operates the Provenance ecosystem alongside Figure Markets and Figure Technology Solutions, now headquartered in Reno with hubs in San Francisco and New York. Backed by leading investors and banks, Figure emphasizes responsible lending, auditable rails and efficient credit at scale. Expect a culture that blends fintech execution, regulatory discipline and practical application of blockchain to real-world financial products.

allium.name: Allium
allium.description: Allium, founded in 2021 by Ethan Chan and Cheng Han Lee, former engineering leaders at Meta and Primer, in New York, provides enterprise blockchain data infrastructure for institutions. Its platform ingests, normalizes and indexes data from numerous chains to deliver real-time analytics, compliance queries and warehouse-ready datasets for banks, fintechs and crypto firms. Clients use Allium to monitor stablecoin flows, decode smart contracts and power dashboards without running nodes. Backed by leading investors including Theory Ventures and Kleiner Perkins, Allium emphasizes data accuracy, low-latency pipelines and SQL accessibility for analysts. Headquartered in New York with a distributed engineering team, the company bridges Web2 data expectations with on-chain complexity. Expect a data-obsessed culture that values pipeline reliability, customer-driven product and turning raw blocks into actionable intelligence.

skip-protocol.name: Skip Protocol
skip-protocol.description: Skip Protocol is a core infrastructure company building sovereign blockchain developer tooling, MEV capture mechanisms, block building architectures, and cross-chain routing systems across Cosmos, Solana, and EVM ecosystems. Its Skip Go API allows wallets and dApps to find the fastest, cheapest multi-hop swap routes across any chain with one click. Backed by Bain Capital Crypto and leading investors, Skip values distributed systems engineering, market microstructure research, and building open-source public goods. Skip's cross-chain routing engine and MEV infrastructure enable developers to orchestrate single-click multi-token swaps and execute optimal trade paths across diverse blockchain ecosystems. Skip Protocol builds MEV capture tools and cross-chain routing engines that enable seamless multi-token swaps and optimal execution across modular blockchains.

animoca-brands.name: Animoca Brands
animoca-brands.description: Animoca Brands, founded in 2014 by Yat Siu in Hong Kong, is a leading Web3 gaming, metaverse and digital property company. Through investments in a broad portfolio of companies and products including The Sandbox, Phantom Galaxies and Mocaverse, it champions digital ownership via NFTs and tokens. The firm operates publishing, advisory and investment arms that help studios launch token economies and marketplaces serving a wide player base. Headquartered in Hong Kong with offices in Singapore, London and Sydney, Animoca blends game development, IP partnerships and on-chain infrastructure. Backed by leading investors including Temasek and Sequoia China, it advocates for an open metaverse. Expect a creative, entrepreneurial culture that values gaming craft, community ownership and building the infrastructure for an inclusive, player-owned internet today.

injective-labs.name: Injective Labs
injective-labs.description: Injective Labs is the core developer of Injective, a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain optimized for building decentralized finance applications, spot and derivatives exchanges, and prediction markets.

crypto-finance.name: Crypto Finance
crypto-finance.description: Crypto Finance, founded in 2017 by Jan Brzezek, Marc P. Bernegger and Tobias Reichmuth in Zug, delivers regulated institutional services for digital assets under Swiss FINMA oversight. As part of Deutsche Börse Group since its 2021 acquisition, it offers custody, staking, tokenization and brokerage for banks and professional investors via Crypto Storage AG and Crypto Brokerage. The group was among the first to receive a Swiss securities house license for crypto, enabling compliant access to trading and yield products. Headquartered in Zug with offices in Zurich, the firm connects traditional banking rails with on-chain settlement. Backed by Deutsche Börse and leading investors, it emphasizes audit, segregation and operational excellence. Expect a precise, compliance-first culture where engineers and risk teams collaborate closely with regulators and institutional clients.

taxbit.name: TaxBit
taxbit.description: TaxBit, founded in 2018 by Austin Woodward, Justin Woodward and Mike Hudson in Draper, Utah, develops tax and accounting software for digital assets. Its platform automates transaction aggregation across numerous exchanges and wallets, cost-basis calculation, gains reporting and withholding for enterprises, governments and consumers. Used by the IRS and Big Four accounting partners, TaxBit provides audit-ready records, information reporting and compliance APIs for brokers meeting regulatory obligations. Headquartered in Draper with offices in Seattle and London, TaxBit serves a broad user base through direct and embedded integrations. Backed by leading investors including Haun Ventures and Paradigm, the company sits at the nexus of finance, regulation and crypto. Expect a mission-driven, compliance-focused culture that values accuracy, customer trust and making crypto accounting seamless.

ndax.name: Ndax
ndax.description: Ndax, founded in 2017 by Bilal Hammoud in Calgary, Alberta, is one of Canada's premier regulated cryptocurrency exchanges and digital asset trading platforms. Registered as a Money Services Business with FINTRAC and regulated by Canadian securities administrators, Ndax offers retail and institutional clients deep CAD fiat rails, spot trading, staking and automated portfolio tools with multi-signature cold storage and Canadian bank settlement. Headquartered in Calgary with teams across Canada, Ndax prioritizes regulatory transparency, reliable banking rails and comprehensive customer support. The team values financial infrastructure reliability, compliance craft and providing Canadian investors with a secure, transparent gateway to digital assets.

layerzero.name: LayerZero
layerzero.description: LayerZero, founded in 2021 by Bryan Pellegrino, Ryan Zarick and Caleb Banister in Vancouver and New York, builds omnichain interoperability infrastructure for blockchains. Its core protocol, LayerZero, provides lightweight messaging via ultra-light nodes and decentralized verifiers that let dApps send data between Ethereum, BNB Chain, Solana, Aptos and dozens of networks without intermediary chains. Stargate and numerous DeFi apps use LayerZero for native bridging, governance and cross-chain execution. Headquartered across Vancouver and New York with a distributed research team, LayerZero combines cryptography, cross-chain security and developer SDKs for omnichain contracts. Backed by leading investors, the project emphasizes verifiable delivery and chain agnosticism. Expect a research and infrastructure culture focused on messaging reliability, security reviews and empowering builders to ship seamlessly cross-chain experiences.

pwc.name: PwC
pwc.description: PwC (PricewaterhouseCoopers) is one of the Big Four professional services networks, providing audit, tax, legal, and Web3 digital asset advisory services to global financial institutions.

fleek.name: Fleek
fleek.description: Fleek is a decentralized edge platform and developer hosting suite for teams building open web applications. The platform helps developers deploy dApps, static sites, IPFS-backed content, and serverless edge functions without relying on a single centralized hosting provider. Fleek has historically focused on making decentralized infrastructure feel as fast and familiar as modern web deployment platforms, giving Web3 teams production workflows for storage, compute, previews, domains, and global delivery. For builders working across Ethereum, IPFS, and open protocols, Fleek sits at the infrastructure layer between application code and decentralized networks.

sui-foundation.name: Sui Foundation
sui-foundation.description: Sui Foundation, established in 2022 in Grand Cayman to steward the Sui blockchain originally built by Mysten Labs, supports a high-performance layer-1 using the Move language and parallel transaction execution. Designed for object-centric assets and sub-second finality, Sui powers gaming, DeFi and consumer apps with features like zkLogin, sponsored transactions and programmable objects. The Foundation administers grants, education, validator programs and ecosystem growth independent of the core builder while coordinating network upgrades. Headquartered in Grand Cayman with ecosystem contributors across the US, Europe and APAC, Sui serves developers launching asset-rich experiences without centralized custody. Backed by ecosystem adoption and anchored by the Move community, it emphasizes safety and scale. Expect a collaborative, ecosystem-focused culture centered on decentralization, Move advocacy and helping builders ship responsive on-chain products for mainstream audiences.

foundry.name: Foundry
foundry.description: Foundry (Foundry Digital) is a turnkey digital asset mining, staking, and advisory firm under Digital Currency Group (DCG). Foundry operates USA-based mining pools (Foundry USA Pool) and institutional staking infrastructure.

morpho.name: Morpho
morpho.description: Morpho is a decentralized lending protocol on Ethereum and Base that optimizes interest rates for borrowers and lenders by matching supply and demand peer-to-peer while falling back on underlying liquidity pools like Compound and Aave. Known for its permissionless Morpho Blue primitives and vault architecture, Morpho prioritizes formal verification, smart contract security, and capital efficiency. Morpho Blue provides permissionless lending primitives that allow risk managers and DeFi protocols to deploy isolated lending markets with customizable collateral parameters and dynamic interest rate curves. Morpho matches supply and demand peer-to-peer while falling back on underlying liquidity pools like Compound and Aave, prioritizing formal verification, smart contract security, and capital efficiency.

mercuryo.name: Mercuryo
mercuryo.description: Mercuryo is a global Web3 payment infrastructure provider building fiat-to-crypto on-ramps, off-ramps, and crypto card solutions for over 3 million users and top Web3 protocols.

lens-protocol.name: Lens Protocol
lens-protocol.description: Lens Protocol, created in 2022 by Stani Kulechov and the Aave Labs team, is a decentralized, open-source social graph that empowers creators to own their digital identities, content and social connections. Built on modular smart contracts and scalable Layer 2 infrastructure, Lens allows developers to construct social applications, messaging platforms and monetization feeds where user profiles and follower relationships are held as sovereign digital assets. Governed as open public infrastructure, Lens fosters developer experimentation, censorship resistance and creator monetization across Web3 social applications. Built on modular smart contracts, Lens Protocol allows creators to own their social connections, content feeds, and digital identity as transferable on-chain assets across decentralized social apps.

optimism.name: Optimism
optimism.description: Optimism, founded in 2019 as Optimism PBC by Jinglan Wang, Karl Floersch, Ben Jones and Kevin Ho in New York, builds the Optimism Collective and OP Stack for Ethereum scaling. Its flagship chain OP Mainnet is an EVM-equivalent optimistic rollup, complemented by the Superchain vision of interoperable rollups sharing sequencing and governance via the OP token and RetroFunding. Developer tooling emphasizes simple migration, low fees and Ethereum alignment with fraud-proof security. Backed by leading investors and stewarded as a public goods experiment with open governance, Optimism serves developers launching DeFi, social and enterprise rollups. Headquartered in New York with a globally distributed collective, the team includes protocol researchers worldwide. Expect a values-driven culture that values public goods funding, governance experimentation and building scalable Ethereum infrastructure with long-term optimism.

keyrock.name: Keyrock
keyrock.description: Keyrock, founded in 2017 by Kevin de Patoul, Juan David Mendieta and Jeremy de Groodt in Brussels, operates as a global digital asset market maker and liquidity provider. Active on numerous exchanges and OTC venues, it provides tight spreads, treasury management and options hedging for token issuers and funds using proprietary algorithmic trading and risk systems. Headquartered in Brussels with offices in London, Zug and New York, Keyrock combines quantitative research, low-latency infrastructure and around-the-clock risk management. Backed by leading investors including Ripple and SIX, it serves a broad range of token projects and institutions worldwide. The firm emphasizes capital efficiency, inventory discipline and transparent reporting. Expect a quantitative, collaborative culture where engineers and traders work closely to maintain reliable liquidity across volatile crypto markets.

bnb-chain.name: BNB Chain
bnb-chain.description: BNB Chain is a community-driven, decentralized Layer 1 blockchain ecosystem powered by BNB. Comprising BNB Smart Chain (BSC), opBNB (Layer 2), and BNB Greenfield (decentralized storage), BNB Chain serves hundreds of millions of users with high-speed, low-cost decentralized finance, Web3 gaming, and AI infrastructure.

harmony.name: Harmony
harmony.description: Harmony, founded in 2017 by Stephen Tse, a former Apple and Google engineer, in San Francisco, develops an Ethereum-compatible layer-1 blockchain using sharding and Effective Proof-of-Stake. Its architecture partitions the network into shards for parallel execution while maintaining cross-shard communication and low fees, targeting scalable DeFi and NFT applications. The Harmony mainnet launched in 2019 with bridge tooling to Ethereum and BNB Chain and a grants program for developers. Headquartered with a distributed team now largely remote, Harmony remains community-governed with open-source development. Backed by leading investors, it emphasizes peer-reviewed research and pragmatic decentralization with a roadmap focused on cross-chain interoperability and zero-knowledge advances. Expect a research-oriented culture that values protocol correctness, community collaboration and perseverance in building scalable, energy-efficient chain infrastructure.

partisia-blockchain.name: Partisia Blockchain
partisia-blockchain.description: Partisia Blockchain is a privacy-preserving Layer 1 network that combines multi-party computation (MPC) with public blockchain consensus to enable confidential data processing on-chain. Built for healthcare, financial compliance, and secure data exchanges, Partisia protects sensitive user data while preserving auditability. Partisia Blockchain integrates privacy-preserving multi-party computation with Layer 1 public consensus, allowing enterprises to execute confidential computations on sensitive data without exposing private state on-chain. Built for healthcare, financial compliance, and confidential data exchanges, Partisia protects proprietary user information while maintaining verifiable auditability. By combining secure multi-party computation with Layer 1 public consensus, Partisia enables privacy-preserving smart contract execution for enterprise compliance, healthcare data, and financial applications.

yellow-card.name: Yellow Card
yellow-card.description: Yellow Card is Africa’s largest regulated pan-African crypto exchange and payment infrastructure platform, operating across 20+ African countries.

fintax.name: FinTax
fintax.description: FinTax is an AI-powered crypto tax compliance, accounting, and reporting platform built for Web3 users, funds, and crypto enterprises to automate tax filing across multi-chain transactions.

coinhako.name: Coinhako
coinhako.description: Coinhako, founded in 2014 by Yusho Liu and Gerry Eng in Singapore, operates a leading licensed crypto exchange for Singapore and the region. Regulated under Singapore's Payment Services Act with a Major Payment Institution license from MAS, it offers spot trading, staking and custody for retail and institutional clients with SGD rails and FAST transfers. Serving millions of verified users, Coinhako emphasizes local compliance, secure cold storage and straightforward mobile onboarding. Headquartered in Singapore with a regional team, it was among the first platforms to receive in-principle approval from MAS and holds additional registrations in ASEAN markets. Backed by leading investors including SBI and Saison, Coinhako focuses on sustainable growth. Expect a compliance-first culture that values operational discipline, customer support and building trusted access to crypto in Singapore.

kiln.name: Kiln
kiln.description: Kiln, founded in 2018 in Paris, is an enterprise-grade staking infrastructure provider enabling institutions, wallets and custodians to offer ETH, SOL and 40+ protocol rewards through APIs, validators and white-label products. Operating audited bare-metal and cloud validators with SOC 2 Type II controls and slashing coverage via Onchain, Kiln serves Ledger, Coinbase, Kraken and major custodians. Headquartered in Paris with hubs in London, Singapore and New York, the firm emphasizes validator performance, MEV-aware reward optimization and compliance-ready reporting. Expect an infrastructure-reliability culture that values protocol correctness, security audits and making staking accessible inside institutional products.

uniswap-labs.name: Uniswap Labs
uniswap-labs.description: Uniswap Labs, founded in 2018 by Hayden Adams in New York, builds the leading decentralized exchange protocol and interfaces for Ethereum and EVM chains. Originating from the Uniswap v1 automated market maker, the Labs developed successive protocol versions including v2, v3 concentrated liquidity and v4 hooks, plus the Uniswap Wallet and UniswapX routing. Its interfaces route billions in monthly volume via smart order routing and aggregation while remaining non-custodial and audited. Headquartered in New York with a distributed team across the US, Uniswap Labs is backed by leading investors and steward of open-source protocol research. The company advances DeFi accessibility and governance via UNI. Expect a product-driven culture focused on mechanism design craft, security review and making self-custody swapping reliable for mainstream users.

bitvavo.name: Bitvavo
bitvavo.description: Bitvavo, founded in 2018 by Tim Baardse, Jelle de Boer and William Boersma in Amsterdam, operates a leading European crypto exchange and brokerage for retail and high-volume traders. Its platform offers spot trading, staking and custody across a broad range of assets with EUR rails, FIX and REST APIs, and institutional custody via Bitvavo Custody. Headquartered in Amsterdam with hubs across the Netherlands, Bitvavo is registered with the Dutch Central Bank as a digital asset service provider and emphasizes fee transparency, orderbook depth and euro liquidity. Serving a broad European retail and professional base, the company focuses on reliable matching, compliance and local support. Backed by growth capital, Bitvavo competes on pricing and reliability. Expect a compliance and execution-focused culture that values platform stability, transparent operations and expanding regulated crypto access in Europe.

0g-labs.name: 0G Labs
0g-labs.description: 0G Labs, founded in 2023 by Michael Heinrich, Ming Wu, Fan Long and Thomas Yao in San Francisco, builds 0G, a modular decentralized AI chain designed as an operating system for AI. Its stack combines a high-throughput data availability and storage layer with compute and serving infrastructure, including 0G Storage, 0G DA and 0G Serving for inference and model orchestration. The architecture targets verifiable AI workflows, on-chain model deployment and data provenance without centralized intermediaries. Backed by leading investors and incubated with research partners across Web3 and AI, 0G is building toward mainnet with testnet participation and ecosystem grants. Headquartered in San Francisco with a distributed research and engineering team and Cayman foundation presence, 0G sits at the intersection of cryptography and machine learning. Expect a research-driven culture that values systems engineering, AI openness and shipping performant infrastructure for decentralized intelligence.

consensys.name: Consensys
consensys.description: Consensys, founded in 2014 by Joseph Lubin, co-founder of Ethereum, in Brooklyn, builds core infrastructure for the Ethereum ecosystem. Its products include MetaMask, the most widely used self-custody wallet serving millions, Infura, the node and API suite powering most dApps, and Linea, a ZK-rollup for scaling. The company also stewards developer tools including Truffle, Besu and Diligence audits for enterprises, governments and protocol teams worldwide. Headquartered in Brooklyn with hubs in London, Paris and globally distributed, Consensys blends product engineering, protocol research and enterprise consulting. Backed by leading investors and enterprise partners, it advances decentralized web standards and ecosystem growth. Expect a mission-driven culture that values Ethereum advocacy, product craftsmanship and building durable, trusted rails for users and developers to access Web3 safely.

solana-foundation.name: Solana Foundation
solana-foundation.description: Solana Foundation, established in 2020 in Zug to steward the Solana network, a high-throughput L1 known for low fees and sub-second finality, operates as a Swiss non-profit. Founded alongside contributors including Anatoly Yakovenko, the Foundation funds protocol R&D, validator programs, grants and education supporting a broad community of users and developers building DeFi, DePIN and consumer apps. Unlike a company, it is a non-profit that allocates resources via grants and ecosystem initiatives rather than custodying user funds. Backed by network adoption and ecosystem contributions, it coordinates upgrades including Firedancer. Headquartered in Zug with core teams in San Francisco, New York and remote globally, the Foundation guides governance and ecosystem growth. Expect a collaborative, developer-focused culture centered on decentralization, network reliability and expanding accessible, composable blockchain infrastructure for mainstream adoption today.

monad-foundation.name: Monad Foundation
monad-foundation.description: Monad Foundation, established in December 2024 to steward the Monad blockchain originally built by Monad Labs, supports the parallel EVM Layer 1 community. The Foundation administers grants, ecosystem programs and governance coordination independent of Monad Labs' commercial engineering, funding research on parallel execution, MonadBFT and EVM compatibility. Headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands, with a globally distributed team and contributor hubs in New York, the Foundation coordinates testnet participation, validator programs and developer onboarding for DeFi and gaming builders migrating Ethereum contracts. The network targets high throughput and low gas fees without rewriting tooling. Governed as open infrastructure, it emphasizes decentralization and ecosystem neutrality. Expect a collaborative, ecosystem-focused culture centered on performance research, developer support and expanding practical infrastructure for demanding on-chain workloads.

shakepay.name: Shakepay
shakepay.description: Shakepay, founded in 2015 by Jean Amiouny and Roy Breidi in Montreal, operates Canada's leading consumer crypto app for buying, selling and paying with bitcoin and ether. Its products include Shakepay Wallet, recurring buys, bill pay, peer transfers and the Shakepay Card that lets users spend crypto balances at merchants with e-Transfer rails for CAD funding. Headquartered in Montreal with hubs in Toronto and remote across Canada, Shakepay emphasizes simple mobile UX, customer education and compliance under Canadian FINTRAC oversight rather than complex derivatives. Serving a broad retail base, the company navigates evolving regulation with a trust-first approach. Backed by growth capital, it focuses on reliable funding rails and support. Expect a customer-centric culture that values clarity, regulatory craft and expanding accessible, everyday crypto use for Canadians.

compound.name: Compound
compound.description: Compound, originally created in 2018 by Robert Leshner and Geoffrey Hayes in San Francisco and developed by Compound Labs, pioneered algorithmic, autonomous money markets in decentralized finance. Its protocol enables users to supply crypto assets to earn floating interest and borrow against collateral dynamically through smart contracts without intermediaries, governed on-chain by COMP token holders. Compound v3 (Comet) introduced a streamlined, single-borrowable asset model that optimizes capital efficiency and mitigates risk. Headquartered with distributed governance and engineering contributors worldwide, Compound emphasizes formal verification, audited risk parameters and building timeless, permissionless financial infrastructure for global DeFi. Compound v3 (Comet) optimizes capital efficiency and risk management in decentralized finance, providing audited smart contract money markets where users can supply, borrow, and earn yield on digital assets.

grvt.name: GRVT
grvt.description: GRVT, founded in 2022 by Hong Gyu Yea, Aaron Ong and Matthew Quek in Singapore, develops a hybrid exchange that combines centralized orderbook performance with on-chain settlement and privacy. Its platform, GRVT Exchange, offers spot and perpetuals trading with off-chain matching for low latency and zk-based custody that keeps user assets non-custodial while protecting strategy privacy. Headquartered in Singapore with a distributed team across the region, GRVT targets professional traders seeking deep liquidity, self-custody and regulatory readiness without the latency of fully on-chain venues. The exchange operates under offshore licensing with compliance controls and insurance-aware design. Expect a trading and cryptography-focused culture that values execution correctness, risk engineering and building trusted hybrid venues for sophisticated retail and institutional traders daily.

caladan.name: Caladan
caladan.description: Caladan (formerly AlphaLab Capital) is a premier digital asset market maker and quantitative trading firm processing billions in daily volume across 100+ exchanges and DeFi protocols. Utilizing proprietary high-frequency execution algorithms and automated risk management, Caladan provides liquidity for top blockchain projects globally. Caladan provides 24/7 quantitative market making across 100+ crypto exchanges, deploying high-frequency trading algorithms to maintain continuous orderbook liquidity globally. Operating with proprietary algorithmic execution and automated risk management systems, Caladan supplies market liquidity for leading blockchain protocols, tokens, and digital asset venues. Caladan deploys high-frequency algorithmic market making algorithms and automated risk management across 100+ exchanges, providing continuous orderbook liquidity for digital assets.

aptos-labs.name: Aptos Labs
aptos-labs.description: Aptos Labs, founded in 2021 by Mo Shaikh and Avery Ching, former Meta Diem leads, in Palo Alto, develops the Aptos layer-1 blockchain built with the Move programming language. Forked from Diem research, Aptos offers parallel execution via Block-STM, low latency and formal verification for assets, targeting scalable DeFi, gaming and payments for mainstream adoption. Mainnet launched in 2022 with Aptos Foundation grants supporting ecosystem builders worldwide. Headquartered in Palo Alto with hubs in New York and globally remote, Aptos Labs is backed by leading investors including a16z and Jump Crypto. The team emphasizes engineering rigor from large-scale consumer tech. Expect a high-performance culture centered on systems engineering, Move safety and shipping reliable chain upgrades for developers and users today.

sei-labs.name: Sei Labs
sei-labs.description: Sei Labs is the core developer of Sei Network, a high-throughput Layer 1 blockchain engineered specifically for digital asset trading, DEXs, and high-frequency Web3 applications. Featuring built-in order matching engines, sub-second finality, and parallelized EVM execution (Sei v2), Sei Labs brings Wall Street-grade trading speed to decentralized finance. Built with parallelized execution and specialized consensus mechanics, Sei Network delivers sub-second transaction finality and Wall Street-grade orderbook throughput for high-frequency Web3 trading applications. Sei Labs empowers developers to launch high-performance DEXs, perpetual futures markets, and gaming protocols with native EVM compatibility and built-in matching engines. Sei's architecture optimizes orderbook liquidity, sub-second execution, and high-concurrency smart contract throughput, bringing Wall Street-grade trading infrastructure to the Web3 ecosystem.

coinmarketcap.name: CoinMarketCap
coinmarketcap.description: CoinMarketCap, founded in 2013 by Brandon Chez in New York, became the most visited crypto price-tracking site for prices, volumes and portfolio metrics. Now a subsidiary of Binance since 2020, CoinMarketCap aggregates data across numerous exchanges for coins, DeFi, NFTs and derivatives while maintaining editorial independence, rankings and research content. Headquartered in Dover, Delaware, with a globally distributed team, the platform serves a broad audience of consumers and professionals referencing its data for trading and media. Its methodology emphasizes transparent scoring, API access and educational content rather than trading venue operation. The business monetizes through advertising, APIs and events. Its research, newsletters and conference presence extend beyond aggregation to provide educational content that helps newcomers interpret market structure and on-chain signals. Expect a data and audience-focused culture that values coverage breadth, editorial neutrality and delivering accessible market information for everyday crypto users worldwide.

amber-group.name: Amber Group
amber-group.description: Amber Group, founded in 2017 by Michael Wu, Thomas Zhu, Tiantian Kullander and colleagues in Hong Kong and Singapore, operates as a global digital asset market maker, liquidity provider and wealth platform. Its services span OTC trading, electronic market making, structured products and Amber Premium for high-net-worth clients, with coverage across spot, derivatives and DeFi. Headquartered in Singapore with offices in Hong Kong, Seoul and London, Amber combines quantitative trading, risk systems and 24/7 operations. The firm emphasizes risk discipline, treasury management and institutional-grade execution across centralized and decentralized venues. Backed by leading investors, Amber navigated market cycles to focus on sustainable liquidity provision. Expect a markets-driven culture that values quantitative rigor, operational discipline and reliable service in volatile crypto conditions.

yeet.name: YEET
yeet.description: YEET is an interactive decentralized social gaming and tokenized entertainment platform that combines casual mobile gameplay with on-chain rewards and community incentives. Built for consumer adoption, YEET provides frictionless digital asset ownership and social viral loops for Web3 gamers. YEET combines casual mobile gameplay with tokenized rewards and social community loops, giving mainstream users frictionless access to digital asset ownership and Web3 gaming incentives. Built for consumer adoption, the platform utilizes verifiable random functions and gasless onboarding to create viral, interactive Web3 gaming experiences. YEET bridges casual mobile gaming with digital asset incentives, creating engaging social gaming loops and provably fair rewards for players worldwide.

amazon.name: Amazon
amazon.description:
Amazon is a global technology company spanning e-commerce, cloud computing (AWS), devices, and logistics. AWS builds cloud infrastructure used by startups and enterprises worldwide, including financial services, digital assets, and emerging-technology consulting.

Amazon.com, Inc. operates consumer retail, Prime, and Amazon Web Services (AWS). AWS Professional Services and industry teams help customers migrate, modernize, and adopt cloud, data, and emerging technologies at scale.

swan-bitcoin.name: Swan Bitcoin
swan-bitcoin.description: Swan Bitcoin, founded in 2019 by Cory Klippsten, Yan Pritzker and Brady Swenson in Los Angeles, is a dedicated Bitcoin financial services company providing automated recurring buys, high-net-worth OTC trading, institutional custody and Bitcoin IRA products. Swan focuses exclusively on Bitcoin accumulation and self-custody education, operating with transparent fees, zero altcoin trading and audited partner custody. Headquartered in Los Angeles with a fully remote US workforce, Swan also produces extensive macroeconomic research, books and podcasts. Backed by prominent Bitcoin investors, the company prioritizes customer education, direct client advisory and building durable financial tools that help individuals and corporations hold Bitcoin safely long-term.

gsr-markets.name: GSR Markets
gsr-markets.description: GSR Markets, founded in 2013 by Cristian Gil and Richard Rosenblum in London, operates as a leading crypto market maker and liquidity provider for spot and derivatives. Its businesses span OTC trading, systematic market making and treasury management for exchanges, token projects and institutions, with coverage across numerous exchanges and deep stablecoin liquidity. Headquartered in London with hubs in New York, Singapore and Zug, GSR combines algorithmic pricing, around-the-clock risk and credit facilities that support launch and secondary liquidity for token issuers. Regulated in several jurisdictions and expanding in the US, GSR emphasizes inventory discipline and reliable execution during volatility. Expect a quantitative, markets-driven culture that values pricing rigor, risk control and operating as dependable liquidity rails for sophisticated trading counterparties.

solflare.name: Solflare
solflare.description: Solflare, founded in 2021 by Vidor Gencel and Filip Dragoslavic as a community-built Solana wallet, provides a leading non-custodial wallet for Solana and emerging ecosystems. Available as browser extension, mobile and web, it offers staking, swaps, NFT gallery and Ledger support with direct integration to Solana dApps. Serving a broad user base as one of the original Solana ecosystem wallets, Solflare is non-custodial, audited and focused on Solana-native UX with transaction simulation and phishing warnings. Headquartered with a distributed team across Croatia, Serbia and globally remote, Solflare maintains close collaboration with the Solana Foundation and validator community. Backed by ecosystem grants and community growth, it emphasizes self-sovereignty. Expect a community-driven culture centered on Solana advocacy, security mindfulness and delivering fast, accessible wallet experiences for everyday users.

magic-eden.name: Magic Eden
magic-eden.description: Magic Eden, founded in 2021 by Jack Lu, Sidney Zhang, Zhuoxun Yin and Zhuojie Zhou in San Francisco, operates a leading multichain NFT and digital collectibles marketplace spanning Solana, Ethereum, Polygon and Bitcoin Ordinals. Its platform offers launchpad, aggregation, wallet and creator royalty tooling for trading, minting and managing collections with low fees and fast indexing. Headquartered in San Francisco with a distributed team, Magic Eden grew from a Solana-native marketplace to a cross-chain venue serving a broad collector base and thousands of creators. Emphasizing curation, discovery and pro-trader features, it supports both retail and professional workflows with mobile and API access. Backed by leading investors, it invests in marketplace infra and creator grants. Expect a fast-moving, marketplace-driven culture that values creator relationships, product iteration and reliable trading at NFT scale.

grayscale.name: Grayscale
grayscale.description: Grayscale, founded in 2013 in New York as a subsidiary of Digital Currency Group, is the world's largest crypto asset manager, offering regulated single-asset trusts and ETFs including GBTC (Bitcoin) and ETHE (Ethereum) alongside dozens of altcoin products. Managing tens of billions in AUM for institutions, advisors and retirement accounts, Grayscale won its landmark 2023 court case against the SEC that paved the way for US spot Bitcoin ETFs. Headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut with a New York presence, the firm emphasizes regulated access, custody with Coinbase, and institutional research. Expect a compliance-first asset management culture that values fiduciary rigor, regulatory engagement and expanding mainstream crypto allocation channels.

trezor.name: Trezor
trezor.description: Trezor, created in 2013 by Marek Palatinus (Slush) and Pavol Rusnak (Stick) under SatoshiLabs in Prague, Czech Republic, is the inventor of the world's first hardware cryptocurrency wallet. Its flagship open-source devices, including Trezor Model One, Trezor Safe 3 and Trezor Safe 5, paired with the Trezor Suite desktop app, provide millions of users across 150+ countries with audited cold-storage security, Shamir backup seed protection and coinjoin privacy. Operating with an uncompromising commitment to open-source hardware and firmware transparency, Trezor values self-custody sovereignty, cypherpunk ethics and rigorous user security. SatoshiLabs' Trezor hardware wallets provide open-source cold storage security, Shamir backup seed protection, and audited firmware transparency for crypto users worldwide.

saga.name: Saga
saga.description: Saga, founded in 2022 by Rebecca Liao, Jin Kwon, Jacob McDorman and Bogdan Alexandrescu in San Francisco, is a modular Layer 1 protocol that allows developers to automatically deploy dedicated, high-performance 'Chainlets' on demand. Built for gaming, entertainment and scalable Web3 applications, Saga provides limitless horizontal scaling, predictable gas-free user experiences and automated validator security orchestration derived from Saga's mainnet validators. Headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area with a global collective, Saga is backed by leading venture funds and governed via the SAGA token. The culture prizes developer empowerment, modular architecture research and scaling web3 consumer ecosystems. Saga's automated validator orchestration enables developers to launch dedicated, high-performance Chainlets on demand with predictable gas-free user experiences and horizontal scaling.

sky-mavis.name: Sky Mavis
sky-mavis.description: Sky Mavis, founded in 2018 by Trung Nguyen, Aleksander Larsen, Andy Ho, Jeffrey Zirlin and Tu Doan in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, is the gaming studio behind Axie Infinity and the Ronin blockchain. Its flagship game pioneered play-to-earn with collectible Axies, marketplace trading and token economies that reached global adoption in 2021, while Ronin provides an Ethereum-linked sidechain optimized for gaming with low fees and fast finality. Headquartered in Ho Chi Minh City with a base in Singapore, Sky Mavis combines game development, chain infrastructure and publishing tools for player-owned economies. After navigating the 2022 Ronin bridge exploit and rebuild, the team doubled down on security, creator programs and ecosystem grants. Backed by leading investors, it continues to support developers building on Ronin. Expect a resilient, game-first culture that values community building, economy design and shipping polished experiences for mainstream players.

uphold.name: Uphold
uphold.description: Uphold, founded in 2014 as Bitreserve by Halsey Minor with headquarters in New York and London, operates a multi-asset digital money platform for trading, custody and payments across crypto, fiat and metals. Its core product provides brokerage, wallet and card services with transparent reserve holdings and real-time proof of assets, serving retail and enterprise clients across 150+ countries. Headquartered across the US and UK with hubs in Portugal and Brazil, Uphold emphasizes regulatory coverage, integrated trading rails and connectivity to banking networks for fast funding. The platform supports 50+ currencies and stablecoins with on-chain transparency and compliance tooling for consumer and B2B use cases. Licensed in multiple jurisdictions, it focuses on accessible trading and treasury movement. Expect a compliance-aware, product-focused culture that values transparent operations, payments reliability and expanding practical access to digital assets.

axiom.name: Axiom
axiom.description: Axiom is a zero-knowledge coprocessor for Ethereum that provides smart contracts with trustless access to historical blockchain data and compute. By generating ZK-SNARK proofs of past state, transactions, and receipts, Axiom enables developers to build data-rich dApps, retroactive rewards, on-chain identity systems, and dynamic DeFi without relying on centralized oracles. Backed by top crypto venture firms, Axiom combines cutting-edge cryptography with developer-first tooling. The engineering bar emphasizes applied cryptography, halo2 circuit design, and EVM internals. Axiom utilizes ZK-SNARK proofs to give Ethereum smart contracts trustless access to historical blockchain data, enabling data-rich dApps and dynamic DeFi applications. Axiom utilizes ZK-SNARK proofs to give Ethereum smart contracts trustless access to historical blockchain data, enabling data-rich dApps and dynamic DeFi applications.

revolut.name: Revolut
revolut.description: Revolut, founded in 2015 by Nikolay Storonsky and Vlad Yatsenko in London, is a global financial superapp serving 80+ million customers worldwide. Its Crypto product suite enables non-custodial and custodial crypto trading, staking, Revolut Ramp, and crypto payment rails for retail and institutional users across Europe, Asia, and global markets.

notabene.name: Notabene
notabene.description: Notabene, founded in 2020 by Pelle Brændgaard, Ania Lipinska and Andres Dupont with headquarters in New York, provides Travel Rule compliance infrastructure for crypto. Its platform, SafeTransact and dashboard, automates peer VASP discovery, secure data exchange and reconciliation that helps exchanges and wallets meet FATF Travel Rule obligations when transferring assets between institutions. Serving exchanges, custodians and banks across numerous jurisdictions, Notabene handles encrypted identity exchange, Sunrise assessments and reporting without exposing consumer data on-chain. Headquartered in New York with offices in Berlin and Lisbon, Notabene emphasizes interoperability, data privacy and regulator-ready audit trails. Backed by leading investors, it operates as SaaS rather than custody. Expect a compliance and privacy-focused culture that values secure data engineering, regulatory engagement and enabling institutions to transfer assets safely and compliantly.

bitkub.name: Bitkub
bitkub.description: Bitkub is Thailand’s premier regulated cryptocurrency exchange and digital asset platform, operating Thailand’s largest digital asset exchange venue alongside Bitkub Chain, a high-speed EVM-compatible enterprise blockchain.

immutable.name: Immutable
immutable.description: Immutable, founded in 2018 by James Ferguson, Robbie Ferguson and Alex Connolly in Sydney, builds Web3 gaming infrastructure including Immutable X and Immutable zkEVM for Ethereum scaling. Its products provide gas-free minting, orderbook liquidity and passport wallets that let games onboard players without exposing chain complexity, powering titles including Gods Unchained and Guild of Guardians. Headquartered in Sydney with hubs in Singapore and Los Angeles, Immutable emphasizes gaming-grade UX, carbon-conscious scaling and partnerships with studios and marketplaces. The platform handles significant in-game asset volume via StarkEx and ZK rollup technology developed with StarkWare. Backed by leading investors, Immutable funds developer grants and publishes research on game economies. Expect a game-first culture that values player experience, economy design and shipping reliable scaling for mainstream gaming adoption.

gauntlet.name: Gauntlet
gauntlet.description: Gauntlet, founded in 2018 by Tarun Chitra, a former D. E. Shaw researcher, with Rei Chiang and John Morrow in New York, provides quantitative risk management and optimization for DeFi protocols. Its simulation platform models market, liquidity and liquidation risk to recommend parameter changes for lenders including Aave, Compound and Uniswap, protecting billions in TVL with data-driven proposals. Using agent-based simulations and formal methods, Gauntlet acts as an independent risk partner for DAOs and foundations. Headquartered in New York with a distributed research team, Gauntlet is backed by leading investors including Paradigm and Ribbit. The team blends finance, engineering and data science. Expect an analytical culture that prizes rigorous modeling, clear communication with governance communities and accountable stewardship of protocol risk.

delphi-digital.name: Delphi Digital
delphi-digital.description: Delphi Digital, founded in 2018 by Anil Lulla, Yan Liberman, Kevin Kelly and Tom Shaughnessy in New York, is a leading institutional research, consulting and venture investment firm dedicated exclusively to the crypto and digital asset ecosystem. Through Delphi Research, Delphi Labs and Delphi Ventures, the firm delivers institutional-grade market analysis, economic mechanism design and early-stage capital to pioneering DeFi and Layer 1/2 protocols. Known for rigorous on-chain modeling and deep thesis-driven research, Delphi prizes analytical clarity, intellectual honesty and long-term ecosystem building. Delphi Digital provides institutional research, quantitative tokenomics design, and early-stage venture capital, partnering with top founders to build enduring Web3 protocols.

arch-network.name: Arch Network
arch-network.description: Arch Network is an execution layer engineered to bring native smart contracts and high-throughput programmability directly to Bitcoin. Utilizing zero-knowledge virtual machine (ZKVM) technology and decentralized validator threshold cryptography, Arch enables developers to build DeFi, lending markets, and complex state machines verified natively by Bitcoin without wrapping tokens or relying on centralized bridges. Backed by top venture funds, Arch Network emphasizes cryptographic engineering, low-latency execution engines, and Bitcoin-native protocol research. Arch Network combines zero-knowledge virtual machine (ZKVM) execution with threshold cryptography, allowing developers to deploy high-performance smart contracts natively verified on the Bitcoin network. Arch Network utilizes zero-knowledge virtual machine execution and threshold cryptography to bring native, high-throughput smart contracts directly to the Bitcoin blockchain.

waterfall.name: Waterfall
waterfall.description: Waterfall Network, founded in 2020 and headquartered with registrations in Singapore and Switzerland and an office in New York, develops a highly scalable BlockDAG EVM-compatible Layer 1 protocol for decentralized applications. The distributed protocol is based on Directed Acyclic Graph technology with fast-finality proof-of-stake consensus that enables parallel block production and high throughput while remaining fully EVM compatible for porting Ethereum dApps. Mainnet went live in mid-2024 after extensive testnet iterations and research collaborations, aiming to let validators run on low-cost hardware including laptops and mobile devices. Backed by ByteTrade Lab, Waterfall targets developers seeking scalable smart contract infrastructure without sacrificing decentralization. Expect a research-driven culture that values DAG correctness, validator accessibility and building durable, low-fee rails for decentralized application scale.

braiins.name: Braiins
braiins.description: Braiins, founded in 2011 by Jan Capek and Pavel Moravec in Prague, develops Bitcoin mining software and fleet management around the legacy of Slush Pool, the first Bitcoin mining pool launched in 2010 by Marek Palatinus. Its products include Braiins Pool with Stratum V2, Braiins OS+ firmware for ASIC optimization, and Braiins Toolbox for monitoring and profit switching across large fleets. Headquartered in Prague with a globally distributed team, Braiins serves industrial miners optimizing uptime, efficiency and hashrate transparency since Bitcoin's early years. The firm pioneered open mining standards, Stratum protocol improvements and transparency dashboards after taking over Slush Pool operations in 2013. Operating as a miner-aligned company, it emphasizes firmware correctness and pool reliability over custodial services. Expect an engineering-driven culture that values Bitcoin openness, fleet performance and building practical tooling for professional mining operations at scale.

mysten-labs.name: Mysten Labs
mysten-labs.description: Mysten Labs, founded in 2021 by Evan Cheng, Sam Blackshear, Adeniyi Abiodun, George Danezis and Kostas Chalkias, former Meta Diem leads, in Palo Alto, builds the infrastructure behind Sui and Move. Originating from Diem and Novi research, Mysten developed the Move language extensions, Narwhal-Bullshark consensus and parallel execution that underpin Sui's object model and low-latency performance. Its product suite also includes DeepBook, Walrus decentralized storage and SuiNS for decentralized identity. Headquartered in Palo Alto with hubs in New York, London and global remote, Mysten is backed by leading investors and bridges academic research with shipping production chains. The team combines systems engineering, cryptography and language design expertise. Expect a high-performance culture centered on research rigor, secure language tooling and delivering reliable, developer-friendly blockchain infrastructure.

the-block.name: The Block
the-block.description: The Block is a premier digital asset research, news, and data platform providing data-driven insights, institutional research, and news on Web3.

telcoin.name: Telcoin
telcoin.description: Telcoin, founded in 2017 by Paul Neuner and Claude Eguienta with headquarters in Los Angeles and Singapore, builds telecom-integrated crypto payments and remittance infrastructure. Its core products include Telcoin Mobile, stablecoin issuance and the Telcoin Network, a decentralized telecom validator layer that extends mobile carrier reach into compliant money movement. Focused on leveraging existing carrier billing and compliance relationships, Telcoin aims to bring fast, low-cost transfers and stablecoin rails to mobile users worldwide, particularly for remittances. Headquartered between the US and Singapore with a globally distributed team, the company navigates telecom regulation and financial licensing in tandem. It stewards open development alongside carrier partnerships and app distribution. Expect a mission-driven culture centered on financial inclusion, carrier collaboration and building compliant bridges between telecom and Web3 at scale.

matter-labs.name: Matter Labs
matter-labs.description: Matter Labs, founded in December 2018 by Alex Gluchowski and Alexandr Vlasov in Berlin, develops ZKsync, the ZK-rollup ecosystem for Ethereum scaling. Its flagship ZKsync Era uses zero-knowledge proofs for validity-based settlement, account abstraction and low gas fees, complemented by ZK Stack for builders launching custom ZK chains and Prividium for enterprise privacy. The team emphasizes open-source development, proof system advances and EVM compatibility for easy migration. Headquartered in Berlin with hubs in New York and globally remote, Matter Labs is backed by leading investors and supports millions through ecosystem wallets and apps. The company works closely with researchers on recursive proofs and prover efficiency. Expect an engineering-heavy culture focused on cryptographic excellence, developer experience and scaling Ethereum without compromising security or user self-custody.

helius.name: Helius
helius.description: Helius, founded in 2022 by Mert Mumtaz, Liam Vovk and Nicolas Pennie in the United States, provides Solana-native developer infrastructure spanning RPC nodes, APIs, webhooks and indexing for high-performance crypto apps. Created during the bear market by former Coinbase and Amazon engineers who met at Queen's University, Helius lets developers build without wrestling with unreliable nodes, complex streaming or costly archival data. Headquartered with a remote-first team distributed across North America, Europe and Asia, it powers staking, validator services and data tooling used throughout the Solana ecosystem. The platform emphasizes low latency, cost efficiency and reliable uptime for DeFi, payments and DePIN workloads. Backed by Haun Ventures and Founders Fund, Helius focuses on Solana-only depth over multichain breadth. Expect an engineering-heavy culture that prizes Solana expertise, performance tuning and responsive support for builders at scale.

openzeppelin.name: OpenZeppelin
openzeppelin.description: OpenZeppelin, founded in 2015 by Demian Brener and Manuel Araoz in the United States with a globally distributed team, defines the security standard for smart contract development. Its open-source Contracts library is the most widely used collection of audited Solidity primitives for tokens, governance and access control, while its Defender platform and audit practice secure mission-critical systems for leading DeFi protocols and financial institutions. Originally known as Zeppelin and founded in Buenos Aires, the company pioneered formal smart contract audits and education through Ethernaut. Headquartered in the United States with teams across 30+ countries, OpenZeppelin operates as a security-first product and services firm emphasizing research, formal verification and continuous monitoring. Its work underpins a significant share of value secured on Ethereum and L2s. Backed by leading investors, it advances open, reusable standards. Expect a rigorous, audit-minded culture that values code correctness, clear documentation and stewardship of shared infrastructure.

crystal-intelligence.name: Crystal Intelligence
crystal-intelligence.description: Crystal Intelligence, founded in 2018 as Crystal Blockchain within Bitfury Group and headquartered in Amsterdam with offices in London, provides blockchain analytics for compliance, investigations and risk monitoring. Its platform traces transactions across Bitcoin, Ethereum and numerous chains, linking addresses to entities, scoring risk and generating alerts for exchanges, banks and regulators. Used by financial intelligence units and VASPs to meet AML and Travel Rule obligations, Crystal combines clustering heuristics with case-management workflows. Now operating independently as Crystal Intelligence, the company serves institutions worldwide and is backed by Bitfury and leading investors. The team emphasizes accuracy, explainability and regulator-ready reporting. Expect a detail-oriented culture that values investigative rigor, data quality and helping make crypto markets safer and more transparent today.

bitcoin-com.name: Bitcoin.com
bitcoin-com.description: Bitcoin.com, founded in 2015 by Roger Ver and team after acquiring the domain in 2014, provides consumer wallet, news and education services centered on Bitcoin and Bitcoin Cash. Its flagship non-custodial wallet supports Bitcoin, Bitcoin Cash, Ethereum and other assets with swaps, staking and learning rewards, while Bitcoin.com News delivers market coverage for retail audiences. Headquartered in Saint Kitts and Nevis with a globally distributed team, Bitcoin.com pioneered retail onboarding and merchant education for peer-to-peer electronic cash. The brand navigated community forks to focus on accessible self-custody and transparent fees rather than exchange custody. Serving a broad global retail base, it emphasizes approachable product and advocacy. Expect a consumer-focused culture that values self-custody education, straightforward UX and expanding practical cryptocurrency use for everyday payments.

localcoin.name: Localcoin
localcoin.description: Localcoin operates one of North America's largest physical cryptocurrency ATM networks, providing thousands of retail kiosk locations across Canada and the United States. Localcoin enables everyday consumers to buy and sell Bitcoin, Ethereum, and digital assets instantly with physical cash through compliant, user-friendly terminals. Localcoin operates thousands of cash-to-crypto kiosk terminals across North America, giving everyday consumers a compliant physical gateway to trade digital assets. Localcoin enables retail users to buy and sell Bitcoin, Ethereum, and digital currencies instantly with cash through user-friendly retail kiosks integrated with local banking rails. Localcoin operates thousands of retail cash-to-crypto kiosk terminals across North America, providing a secure, compliant physical gateway for consumers to buy and sell Bitcoin.

crossmint.name: Crossmint
crossmint.description: Crossmint, founded in 2022 by Rodri Fernandez and Alfonso Gomez-Jordana in New York and San Francisco, provides embedded wallet and minting infrastructure for enterprises and consumer apps. Its APIs let developers create wallets via email or OAuth, sponsor gas, handle cross-chain payments and manage verifiable credentials without requiring users to write seed phrases. Headquartered in New York with San Francisco presence and a distributed team, Crossmint serves brands, fintechs and gaming studios embedding NFTs, loyalty and stablecoin checkout with enterprise-grade custody and compliance controls. The platform supports major clouds and EVM plus Solana chains, emphasizing checkout conversion and key abstraction. Backed by leading investors, it focuses on invisible Web3 UX. Expect a product and enterprise-focused culture that values integration reliability, thoughtful onboarding and helping mainstream companies launch blockchain features without crypto complexity.

beam.name: Beam
beam.description: Beam is an open-source gaming blockchain network and software ecosystem launched by Merit Circle DAO. Built as a flexible Avalanche subnet and EVM network, Beam provides game developers with seamless account abstraction SDKs, NFT marketplaces, and in-game asset management tools for mass consumer titles. Beam empowers game studios with seamless account abstraction, NFT marketplaces, and in-game asset management SDKs built on high-performance Avalanche subnet infrastructure. Launched by Merit Circle DAO, Beam provides game developers with full-stack tools to build, deploy, and scale player-owned game economies. Built on high-performance Avalanche subnet infrastructure, Beam empowers game studios with account abstraction SDKs, NFT marketplaces, and player-owned gaming economies.

smartx.name: SmartX
smartx.description: SmartX is a Web3 financial technology platform offering compliant digital asset custody, prime brokerage services, and tokenization rails.

etherscan.name: Etherscan
etherscan.description: Etherscan, founded in 2015 by Matthew Tan in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, operates the most widely used Ethereum block explorer and analytics suite. Its platform provides transaction lookup, contract verification, gas tracking, token approvals and APIs that developers, researchers and compliance teams use to inspect Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon and many EVM networks. Headquartered in Kuala Lumpur with a distributed ops team, Etherscan emphasizes data accuracy, low-latency indexing and transparent labeling that underpins due diligence across the ecosystem. Independent and bootstrapped, the company monetizes via APIs, ads and enterprise data while maintaining neutral, open access to chain data. Expect a data infrastructure culture that prizes indexing reliability, security labeling and empowering users to verify on-chain activity with trustworthy tooling every day.

blackbird-labs.name: Blackbird Labs
blackbird-labs.description: Blackbird Labs, founded in 2022 by Ben Leventhal, co-founder of Eater and Resy, in New York, builds consumer payments and loyalty infrastructure for restaurants using stablecoins and blockchain rails. Its products include Blackbird Pay for checkout, Flynet loyalty points and membership tools that let diners earn and redeem rewards across independent restaurants without interchange-heavy cards. Headquartered in New York with hubs in Los Angeles, Blackbird bridges hospitality operations with on-chain settlement, treasury and compliance behind familiar app UX. The platform targets restaurant operators seeking lower fees, direct relationships and data ownership. Backed by leading investors in hospitality and crypto, the team combines restaurant tech and Web3 expertise. Expect a product and partnership-driven culture that values hospitality craft, payments reliability and making blockchain invisible to everyday dining experiences.

ethena-labs.name: Ethena Labs
ethena-labs.description: Ethena Labs, founded in 2023 by Guy Young in Lisbon, Portugal, develops USDe, a synthetic dollar backed by hedged collateral. Its protocol mints USDe against staked ether and bitcoin collateral hedged via perpetual shorts, distributing yield from staking and funding rates through sUSDe savings. Integrated across DeFi lending, perpetuals and custody, Ethena provides on-chain dollar stability without traditional bank issuance, inspired by earlier research on delta-neutral design. Headquartered in Lisbon with a distributed team across Europe, Ethena emphasizes risk engine rigor, transparency dashboards and audited hedging operations. Backed by leading investors including Dragonfly and Arthur Hayes' Maelstrom, the protocol navigates basis and custody risk carefully. Expect a markets and risk-focused culture that values hedging discipline, clear reporting and building stable, yield-bearing dollars for DeFi with operational prudence.

chainstack.name: Chainstack
chainstack.description: Chainstack, founded in 2018 by Laurent Dedenis and Eugene Aseev in Singapore, provides managed blockchain nodes and development infrastructure for enterprises. Its platform offers dedicated and elastic nodes, data APIs and staking integrations across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Solana and many networks without self-hosting hardware. Serving exchanges, analytics and gaming teams that need archival access at scale, Chainstack handles upgrades, peering, backups and strong uptime commitments. Headquartered in Singapore with hubs in London, Hong Kong and distributed globally, Chainstack emphasizes developer self-service, clear documentation and usage-based scaling. The company blends cloud operations with protocol research for emerging chains. Its elastic node features, archive APIs and staking integrations reduce DevOps overhead for teams handling significant transaction volume across emerging and established chains. Expect a reliability-driven culture focused on node uptime, observability and helping developers deploy chain infrastructure without operational overhead.

spruce.name: Spruce
spruce.description: Spruce, founded in 2020 by Wayne Chang and Gregory Rocco in New York, builds open-source identity and data control infrastructure for Web3. Its products, SpruceID and Kepler, provide decentralized identifiers, credential wallets and storage that let users control authentication and data sharing across apps without centralized providers, using DIDs and verifiable credentials. Headquartered in New York with a distributed team, Spruce collaborates with Ethereum Foundation, ENS and government pilots on privacy-preserving identity standards. The company emphasizes open standards, cryptographic verifiability and developer tooling over custodial identity. Backed by leading investors, Spruce advances self-sovereign identity research and interoperability. Its standards collaborations with ENS, Ethereum Foundation and government pilots advance verifiable credential adoption while preserving user control over selective disclosure. Expect a research and standards-driven culture that values privacy engineering, open collaboration and building durable, user-controlled identity rails for the ecosystem.

infstones.name: InfStones
infstones.description: InfStones, founded in 2018 by Zhenwu Shi, former co-founder of Particle Vacuum, and team in Palo Alto, provides enterprise node and staking infrastructure across many chains. Its platform offers managed validators, APIs, data indexing and yield services for Ethereum, Cosmos, Polygon and Solana, handling bare-metal deployment, monitoring and upgrades without self-hosting. Headquartered in Palo Alto with hubs in Singapore and globally distributed, InfStones serves exchanges, custodians and funds staking significant assets with SOC-audited processes and strong uptime commitments. The company blends data center operations with protocol research for emerging networks. Backed by leading investors, it focuses on automation and scale. Expect an operations-centric culture that values node reliability, security discipline and enabling institutions to participate in proof-of-stake with managed, auditable controls.

daylight.name: Daylight
daylight.description: Daylight, founded in 2022 by Kyle McCollom and Morley Zhi in New York, builds an onchain discovery API that helps wallets and apps surface personalized mints, claims and quests based on a user's address history. Former Stellar Development Foundation product and engineering directors, the founders created Daylight to power the home and discovery tabs of major wallets including Coinbase Wallet, MetaMask and Zerion. The platform aggregates opportunities across Ethereum and L2s, normalizing eligibility and transaction metadata for easy integration. Headquartered in Brooklyn with a distributed team, Daylight operates as embedded infrastructure rather than a consumer app, emphasizing data accuracy, indexing reliability and privacy-preserving personalization at scale. Backed by leading investors, it focuses on driving onchain activity for partners without requiring custody. Expect a lean, product-driven culture that values wallet UX craft, thoughtful data engineering and shipping useful discovery quickly.

anagram.name: Anagram
anagram.description: Anagram is a Web3 research, venture capital, and incubator firm supporting early-stage blockchain infrastructure, decentralization protocols, and cryptography research. Founded by industry veterans, Anagram works hands-on with founders on protocol architecture, tokenomics, and go-to-market execution. Anagram collaborates hands-on with early-stage crypto founders, providing venture capital, applied cryptography research, token economic modeling, and protocol architecture guidance. Founded by experienced Web3 investors and systems engineers, Anagram incubates core decentralization infrastructure, zero-knowledge protocols, and distributed network primitives. Anagram supports early-stage crypto founders with strategic seed capital, applied zero-knowledge cryptography research, protocol economic design, and global go-to-market execution. The firm works closely with early-stage teams across multi-chain ecosystems to build resilient decentralized applications.

google.name: Google
google.description:
Google builds search, advertising, cloud, and consumer products used by billions of people. Through Google Cloud and YouTube, it also ships infrastructure and platforms that power payments, digital assets, blockchain, and media at global scale.

Google LLC develops internet products and cloud infrastructure. Google Cloud serves enterprises with compute, data, AI, and industry solutions, including financial-services and digital-asset workloads. YouTube operates the world’s largest video platform, including playback across mobile and living-room screens.

copper-co.name: Copper.co
copper-co.description: Copper.co, founded in 2018 by Dmitry Tokarev in London, provides institutional custody, prime brokerage and settlement via its ClearLoop network. Its core products include MPC-secured custody, off-exchange settlement and lending that lets funds trade on exchanges without pre-funding, reducing counterparty risk. Headquartered in London with hubs in Zug, New York and Singapore, Copper serves hedge funds, banks and neobanks managing digital assets under UK regulatory engagement and Swiss custody licenses. The platform supports 40+ chains, staking and DeFi access with policy-controlled wallets and insurance-aware vaults. Emphasizing segregated accounts and auditability, Copper connects traditional prime services with on-chain settlement. Backed by leading investors, it operates as market infrastructure. Expect a security-conscious, institutional culture that values operational discipline, counterparty risk engineering and reliable service for sophisticated asset managers.

sorare.name: Sorare
sorare.description: Sorare, founded in 2018 by Nicolas Julia and Adrien Montfort in Paris, builds a fantasy sports platform where officially licensed player cards are collected, traded and used in weekly competitions. Its ecosystem spans Sorare Football with 300+ club partnerships, plus Sorare NBA and MLB, combining NFT ownership, game mechanics and marketplace trading on Ethereum and StarkNet scaling. Headquartered in Paris with offices in New York and a remote team, Sorare pioneered licensed digital collectibles with real-world sports utility and secondary royalties for clubs. The platform emphasizes card scarcity design, fair gameplay and licensed IP stewardship while operating regulated contests. Backed by leading investors, it serves a global community of managers and collectors. Expect a product and partnership-driven culture that values sports authenticity, game design craft and building engaging, sustainable fantasy economies.

parity-technologies.name: Parity Technologies
parity-technologies.description: Parity Technologies, founded in 2015 by Gavin Wood, Jutta Steiner and colleagues in Berlin and London, builds foundational blockchain infrastructure including Substrate and Polkadot. Substrate provides a modular framework for launching custom chains with shared security via Polkadot's relay chain, while Parity maintains Ethereum client heritage and ink! smart contracts. Headquartered across Berlin and London with a globally distributed engineering team, Parity stewards open-source development, audit tooling and research on consensus and interoperability. The company emphasizes Rust engineering, formal reasoning and developer autonomy for sovereign chains. Backed by ecosystem endowment, it focuses on long-term protocol resilience over custodial products. Its client maintenance, tooling audits and fellowship grants help chain builders maintain upgradable runtimes and interoperable bridges with formal verification. Expect an engineering-heavy culture that prizes protocol correctness, open-source stewardship and empowering builders to launch resilient, interoperable blockchain networks.

blockworks.name: Blockworks
blockworks.description: Blockworks, founded in 2018 by Michael Ippolito, Jason Yanowitz and Garrett Harper in New York, is a media, events and research company for crypto and financial institutions. Its portfolio includes news and podcasts, Blockworks Research and ETF analytics, plus flagship conferences like Permissionless and DAS that convene thousands of builders and allocators. Headquartered in New York with hubs in London and remote, Blockworks monetizes through subscriptions, sponsorship and institutional data rather than token issuance. It serves a broad audience of investors, founders and policymakers seeking credible coverage and market intelligence. Backed by growth capital and industry partnerships, it emphasizes editorial independence and data-driven insights. Expect a fast-paced, editorial-driven culture that values curiosity, audience understanding and building trusted information infrastructure for the maturing crypto economy.

xapo-bank.name: Xapo Bank
xapo-bank.description: Xapo Bank, originally founded in 2013 as Xapo by Wences Casares in Palo Alto and now headquartered in Gibraltar, operates a licensed private bank integrating Bitcoin custody with traditional banking. As a Gibraltar-regulated bank and supervised VASP, it offers insured Bitcoin custody in underground vaults, interest on bitcoin and USD accounts with dedicated IBANs, plus card spending. Serving high-net-worth members and institutions globally, Xapo emphasizes security through deep cold storage, multi-party computation and inheritance planning. Licensed in Gibraltar with members across many countries, it bridges private banking discretion with Bitcoin conviction. Backed by leading investors including Greylock and Index, Xapo maintains a selective membership model. Expect a security-first culture that values privacy, long-term custody thinking and combining bank-grade compliance with Bitcoin-native product.

dune.name: Dune
dune.description: Dune, founded in 2018 by Fredrik Haga and Mats Olsen in Oslo as Dune Analytics, provides the open blockchain analytics platform used by researchers and teams to query on-chain data. While the brand is often cited as Dune Analytics, the same team and product operate under Dune, offering SQL workspaces, dashboards, decoded tables and APIs across Ethereum, Solana, Polygon and dozens of chains without running nodes. The community has published open dashboards tracking DeFi, stablecoins and governance that are referenced widely by teams and media. Headquartered in Oslo with distributed hubs in New York and globally remote, Dune emphasizes data openness, collaborative forking and reliable pipelines. Expect a community-driven culture centered on data accuracy, documentation quality and empowering analysts to turn raw blocks into trusted intelligence for the ecosystem.

strike.name: Strike
strike.description: Strike, founded in 2020 by Jack Mallers in Chicago as the consumer arm of Zap Solutions, provides Bitcoin-native payments via the Lightning Network for consumers, merchants and enterprises. Its products include Strike App for buying, sending and converting bitcoin to local currency, Strike API for payouts and Lightning invoicing, plus merchant tools that settle in dollars over Lightning rails without custodial compromise. Headquartered in Chicago with operations in El Salvador and a distributed team, Strike emphasizes low fees, instant settlement and regulatory coverage across all US states. A pioneer in Lightning adoption and El Salvador's Bitcoin rollout, the company bridges traditional banking rails with Bitcoin settlement behind simple UX. Backed by leading investors, it focuses on remittances and open payments. Expect a mission-driven culture that values Bitcoin advocacy, payments reliability and expanding instant, low-cost money movement worldwide.

trail-of-bits.name: Trail of Bits
trail-of-bits.description: Trail of Bits, founded in 2012 by Dan Guido and Alexander Sotirov, is a world-renowned cybersecurity research and software assurance firm specializing in blockchain security, smart contract audits, formal verification, and systems cryptography. Creator of industry-standard security tools like Slither, Echidna, and Manticore, Trail of Bits audits the most critical infrastructure in Web3, AI, and defense. The team values deep vulnerability research, open-source security tools, and rigorous technical writing. Trail of Bits develops open-source vulnerability scanners, formal verification frameworks, and smart contract security tools, helping top Web3 protocols and defense agencies secure critical code bases. Trail of Bits conducts deep security audits, formal verification research, and open-source tool development, helping top Web3 protocols and defense clients secure critical systems.

ethereum-institutional.name: Ethereum Institutional
ethereum-institutional.description: Ethereum Institutional is a nonprofit initiative focused on accelerating institutional adoption of the Ethereum network across global financial markets, banking, and capital infrastructure. Through targeted briefings, regulatory research, and enterprise partner coordination, Ethereum Institutional positions Ethereum as foundational infrastructure for global finance. Ethereum Institutional collaborates with tier-one banks, asset managers, and market infrastructure providers to advance understanding, regulatory clarity, and real-world adoption of Ethereum-based financial systems. Through technical workshops, regulatory briefings, and partner alignment, the organization positions Ethereum as foundational infrastructure for global capital markets. Ethereum Institutional collaborates with tier-one banks, asset managers, and capital market infrastructure providers to advance understanding, regulatory clarity, and real-world adoption of Ethereum.

alpen-labs.name: Alpen Labs
alpen-labs.description: Alpen Labs, founded in June 2022 by Simanta Gautam, Pramod Kandel, Chandan Sharma Subedi and Abishkar Chhetri in Brooklyn, New York, builds Bitcoin scaling infrastructure centered on Strata, a ZK rollup for Bitcoin. Its stack uses zero-knowledge proofs to extend Bitcoin with programmable smart contracts and low-cost transactions while anchoring settlement to Bitcoin security via BitVM-inspired constructions. Headquartered in Brooklyn with a research-heavy team across the US and Europe, Alpen emphasizes succinct verification, bridge minimization and developer tooling for Bitcoin-native DeFi and payments. Still advancing toward testnet and ecosystem partnerships, it contributes open research on Bitcoin interoperability and proving. Backed by Ribbit Capital and Castle Island Ventures, the team blends Bitcoin and ZK expertise.
