Expect a research-driven culture that values Bitcoin ethos, cryptographic rigor and building careful, verifiable extensions that respect Bitcoin's base layer guarantees.

coinme.name: Coinme
coinme.description: Coinme, founded in 2014 by Neil Bergquist and Michael Smyers in Seattle, Washington, operates the largest licensed cryptocurrency cash network in the United States. Through strategic nationwide partnerships with Coinstar and MoneyGram, Coinme lets everyday consumers buy and sell bitcoin and digital assets with physical cash at tens of thousands of retail locations across all 50 states. Registered with FinCEN and holding state-by-state Money Transmitter Licenses, Coinme also offers an integrated mobile wallet and enterprise Crypto-as-a-Service APIs. Headquartered in Seattle with a distributed US team, Coinme emphasizes compliance rigor, physical-to-digital financial inclusion and simplifying crypto on-ramping for everyday consumers. Coinme's cash-to-crypto retail network and API platform enable millions of everyday consumers to access digital currency easily across physical locations nationwide with state-by-state regulatory licensing.

river-financial.name: River Financial
river-financial.description: River Financial is an enterprise-grade Bitcoin financial services firm and Lightning Network infrastructure provider offering zero-fee recurring Bitcoin purchases, institutional custody, and Bitcoin mining integration. Its River Lightning API enables banks, fintechs, and crypto platforms to integrate instant, low-cost Lightning Network payments with turn-key node liquidity. Privately funded and US-licensed, River values Bitcoin standard conviction, financial infrastructure reliability, high-touch client support, and security architecture. River Financial combines zero-fee Bitcoin accumulation, enterprise Lightning Network infrastructure APIs, and institutional custody, empowering clients to build on a pure Bitcoin standard. swissborg.name: SwissBorg
swissborg.description: SwissBorg, founded in 2017 by Cyrus Fazel and Anthony Lesoismier in Lausanne, Switzerland, is a leading European crypto wealth management app and investment platform. Operating under Swiss and European regulatory frameworks, SwissBorg provides millions of users across 100+ countries with its Smart Engine that aggregates liquidity across major exchanges for optimal execution, diversified crypto theme baskets (Thematics), and community-governed launchpads. Governed via the BORG token and headquartered in Lausanne with hubs in Lisbon and London, SwissBorg emphasizes transparent proof-of-reserves, intuitive gamified mobile UX and democratic wealth creation for European retail and private investors. SwissBorg provides European retail and private investors with AI-driven liquidity aggregation, thematic crypto baskets, and community launchpads under Swiss regulatory standards.

dakota.name: Dakota
dakota.description: Dakota is a business banking and treasury management platform built specifically for Web3 startups, protocols, and DAOs. Offering high-yield USD treasury accounts, automated yield strategies, free global wire transfers, and corporate cards, Dakota bridges traditional commercial banking with crypto-native operations. Dakota provides corporate crypto banking, yield-bearing USD treasury accounts, and global payout rails built specifically for Web3 startups, protocols, and decentralized organizations. Offering automated yield strategies, zero-fee wire transfers, and corporate cards, Dakota bridges traditional commercial banking with crypto-native financial operations. Dakota provides corporate crypto banking, yield-bearing USD treasury accounts, and global payment rails designed specifically for Web3 startups, protocols, and DAOs.

alliance-dao.name: Alliance DAO
alliance-dao.description: Alliance DAO, founded by Imran Khan and Qiao Wang, is the leading global Web3 accelerator, incubator, and founder community, having backed 200+ top decentralized startups. Providing 12-week intensive cohorts, hands-on tokenomics design, regulatory advisory, liquidity coordination, and a global founder network, Alliance is the launchpad for high-growth crypto founders. Culture values deep crypto-native insight, founder empathy, analytical rigor, and building enduring open web protocols. Alliance DAO provides intensive mentorship, tokenomics advisory, and founder network access to early-stage crypto startups, serving as a premier launchpad for Web3 founders. improbable.name: Improbable
improbable.description: Improbable, founded in 2012 by Herman Narula, Rob Whitehead and Peter Lipka in London, develops metaverse and multiplayer infrastructure that underpins large-scale virtual worlds. Its platforms, SpatialOS and MSquared, provide networking, replication and compute orchestration that let thousands of players and AI agents interact in persistent environments. Headquartered in London with hubs in Cambridge and Edmonton, Improbable serves gaming, defense and enterprise simulations with cloud infrastructure rather than token issuance. Partnering with major studios and Web3 builders exploring open metaverse concepts, the company emphasizes low-latency networking and world persistence. Backed by leading investors, it blends games engineering with distributed systems research. Expect a systems and creative culture that values large-scale simulation craft, reliability under load and building expansive interactive worlds for broad audiences.

groma.name: Groma
groma.description: Groma is a real estate technology and tokenization platform that enables fractional ownership of residential real estate assets through blockchain rails. By combining property management, automated rental distribution, and digital asset security, Groma democratizes access to institutional-grade real estate investments. Groma tokenizes residential real estate assets on blockchain rails, empowering retail investors with fractional property ownership, automated rent distribution, and property management. By combining transparent property administration, digital asset security, and smart contract distribution, Groma democratizes access to institutional-grade real estate portfolios. Groma tokenizes residential real estate portfolios on public blockchains, enabling fractional ownership, automated rental distributions, and transparent property asset management.

foundation.name: Foundation
foundation.description: Foundation (Foundation Devices) builds open-source, air-gapped Bitcoin hardware wallets (Passport) and privacy-focused financial software. Foundation empowers individuals to regain digital sovereignty through secure, air-gapped hardware design and intuitive open-source software.

doublezero.name: DoubleZero
doublezero.description: DoubleZero, founded in 2024 by Austin Federa, former Solana Foundation strategy lead, with a team of network engineers in the United States, builds a high-performance fiber network purpose-built for distributed systems and blockchains. Its protocol coordinates dedicated and contributed fiber links into a permissionless mesh that improves block propagation, reduces latency and increases resilience for validators and RPC operators. Initially focused on Solana, DoubleZero targets infrastructure that makes consensus more democratic by lowering bandwidth constraints for geographically distributed participants. Headquartered with a distributed team across North America, the project combines telecom partnerships with crypto incentive design. Still early-stage, it operates testnet deployments and ecosystem pilots. Expect an infrastructure-focused culture that values network engineering depth, carrier operations and building physical rails for open, performant blockchains.

jump-crypto.name: Jump Crypto
jump-crypto.description: Jump Crypto, established in 2021 as the crypto arm of Jump Trading founded in 1999 by Bill DiSomma and Paul Gurinas in Chicago, builds trading infrastructure, research and ventures for digital assets. Its portfolio includes Pyth Network incubation, Wormhole development, Firedancer Solana client research and proprietary market making across spot and derivatives. Headquartered in Chicago with hubs in New York, London and Singapore, Jump Crypto combines high-frequency trading, cryptography and open-source contributions that influence core ecosystem performance. The team blends quantitative finance with distributed systems engineering and security auditing. Unlike a standalone startup, it operates within Jump Trading's risk and capital framework. Expect a rigorous, research-driven culture that values execution correctness, low-latency engineering and advancing core infrastructure for reliable, high-performance crypto markets.

syndica.name: Syndica
syndica.description: Syndica, founded in 2021 by Ahmad Abbasi and Danial Abbasi in Houston, Texas, provides cloud infrastructure for Solana and other high-throughput chains, with flagship products including dedicated RPC, node management and data APIs. Its platform offers low-latency access, archive nodes and enhanced APIs for token metadata, transactions and staking data used by wallets, DeFi and gaming builders. Headquartered in Houston with a globally distributed team, Syndica emphasizes developer reliability, usage-based scaling and observability for production workloads. By abstracting node operations, it lets teams focus on app logic while handling upgrades, peering and rate limiting at scale. Serving a broad base of Solana builders, Syndica partners closely with ecosystem foundations and infra providers. Expect a developer-centric culture that prizes uptime, clear documentation and practical tooling that helps teams ship quickly on Solana without managing infrastructure.

plasma.name: Plasma
plasma.description: Plasma, founded in 2024 by Paul Faecks and Christian Angermayer and headquartered in London, builds a high-throughput blockchain purpose-built for stablecoin payments. The network optimizes for low fees, fast finality and native issuance of USDT and other dollar stablecoins, with built-in compliance hooks, fiat ramps and treasury tooling for merchants and fintechs. Anchored to Bitcoin via periodic checkpoints and supporting pBTC, Plasma decouples consensus from payments execution to maintain predictable settlement under load. Headquartered in London with a distributed team across the US and Europe and backing from Founders Fund, Framework Ventures and Bitfinex, the project is advancing toward public mainnet and ecosystem partnerships with wallets and neobanks. Expect an execution-driven culture that values payments reliability, regulatory awareness and making stablecoin settlement as seamless as card processing.

nascent.name: Nascent
nascent.description: Nascent, founded in 2020 by Dan Elitzer and a small team in the US with offices in New York and San Francisco, operates as a crypto venture fund and builder collective that combines early-stage investing with technical building. The firm backs founders across DeFi, infrastructure and AI while contributing code, mechanism design and protocol research hands-on as a venture builder rather than a passive allocator. Headquartered with a distributed partnership across the US, Nascent emphasizes deep diligence, founder alignment and open-source contributions to portfolio projects. The team blends investing, engineering and cryptography expertise to support launches from research through mainnet and governance. Expect an intellectually curious culture that values builder empathy, rigorous evaluation and rolling up sleeves alongside founders to tackle hard technical problems.

lightspark.name: Lightspark
lightspark.description: Lightspark, founded in 2022 by David Marcus, former Meta Novi lead, with a senior team from Meta, in Los Angeles, builds enterprise infrastructure for Bitcoin's Lightning Network. Its platform, Lightspark Predict and Lightspark Connect, offers node management, liquidity automation, routing optimization and compliant wallet SDKs that let exchanges, neobanks and wallets send instant low-fee bitcoin payments without operating Lightning directly. Headquartered in Los Angeles with hubs in Austin and remote, Lightspark integrates with banking rails, stablecoin issuance and compliance tooling to bring programmable money to mainstream apps. Backed by leading investors, the team applies consumer-scale payments expertise to Bitcoin. Its tools integrate compliance, risk and reporting that let banks launch compliant Lightning wallets, streaming payments and enterprise treasury flows. Expect a product and infrastructure culture that values reliability, regulatory thoughtfulness and extending Bitcoin for everyday global payments.

airtm.name: Airtm
airtm.description: Airtm is a digital dollar account and cross-border payment platform serving over 1 million users across Latin America and emerging markets. Airtm enables freelancers, digital workers, and remote teams to receive payouts, hold USDC digital dollars, and cash out into local bank accounts with low fees. Airtm provides digital dollar accounts and cross-border payment rails for freelancers and remote workers in emerging markets, facilitating instant USDC payouts and bank settlement. Operating across Latin America and global markets, Airtm enables users to hold digital dollars, send payments, and convert funds into local bank accounts with minimal fees. Airtm provides digital dollar accounts and cross-border payment rails for freelancers and remote workers in emerging markets, facilitating instant USDC payouts and bank settlement.

b2c2.name: B2C2
b2c2.description: B2C2, founded in 2015 by Max Boonen and Flavio Molendini in London, is a leading OTC market maker and single-dealer platform for digital assets. Acquired by SBI Financial Services, B2C2 provides spot, options, CFDs and electronic trading to institutions, exchanges and brokerages with deep liquidity across major pairs and stablecoins. Headquartered in London with hubs in New York, Tokyo and Jersey, B2C2 combines quantitative pricing, 24/7 risk and post-trade settlement that abstracts exchange fragmentation. Regulated as an OTC desk in the UK and expanding in the US and Japan, it serves hundreds of institutional clients. The firm emphasizes tight pricing, inventory discipline and reliable execution during volatility. Expect a markets-driven culture that values quantitative rigor, credit and settlement craft and operating as dependable liquidity rails for sophisticated traders.

starknet-foundation.name: Starknet Foundation
starknet-foundation.description: Starknet Foundation, established in 2022 in the Cayman Islands to steward Starknet, supports the zero-knowledge rollup built by StarkWare for Ethereum scaling. The Foundation allocates grants, governs the STRK token and funds protocol research, tooling and community education independent of StarkWare's commercial development. Starknet uses STARK proofs and the Cairo language for scalable general computation with account abstraction and throughput far beyond L1. Headquartered with a distributed global team and complementary hub in Zug, the Foundation emphasizes decentralization, developer onboarding and public goods funding via voting and delegation. Backed by endowment resources and ecosystem growth, it coordinates upgrades toward full decentralization of sequencing and proving. Expect a community-driven, governance-focused culture that values cryptographic research, builder support and steady progress toward a credibly neutral ZK stack.

polygon-labs.name: Polygon Labs
polygon-labs.description: Polygon Labs, founded in 2017 as Matic Network by Sandeep Nailwal, Jaynti Kanani and Anurag Arjun in Mumbai and now headquartered in Dubai, London and New York, develops Ethereum scaling infrastructure. Its suite spans Polygon PoS, Polygon zkEVM and the AggLayer for aggregated liquidity, plus the Polygon CDK for builders launching sovereign ZK chains. Serving millions through wallets, DeFi and enterprise pilots including Starbucks and Adobe, Polygon emphasizes EVM equivalence, low fees and modular growth for mainstream adoption. Backed by leading investors and stewarded alongside the Polygon Foundation, the ecosystem funds grants, protocol upgrades and zero-knowledge research. The network is open and governed with contributors worldwide. Expect a builder-focused culture that values ecosystem collaboration, scaling pragmatism and helping developers ship affordable, Ethereum-aligned experiences at scale.

particle-network.name: Particle Network
particle-network.description: Particle Network is an Intent-Centric Modular Access Layer providing Universal Accounts, Account Abstraction (ERC-4337), and chain abstraction SDKs for Web3 apps.

logos.name: Logos
logos.description: Logos is building a sovereign, privacy-preserving web stack and zero-knowledge infrastructure layer designed to protect digital rights, free expression, and financial autonomy. Logos incorporates peer-to-peer messaging (Waku), decentralized storage (Codex), and private smart contract execution (Nomos). Logos develops peer-to-peer messaging, decentralized storage, and zero-knowledge privacy infrastructure to preserve digital rights, free expression, and financial autonomy. Incorporating Waku messaging, Codex storage, and Nomos smart contract execution, Logos builds a sovereign, censorship-resistant web stack. jejememe.name: Jejememe
jejememe.description: Jejememe is a Web3 digital entertainment and community engagement studio building gamified social experiences, memes, and digital asset collectibles.

dr-now.name: Dr. Now
dr-now.description: Dr. Now (DoctorNow) is Korea's leading digital healthcare platform and medical technology company. Dr. Now provides remote telemedicine consultations, digital prescription management, and healthcare solutions connecting patients with medical providers across Korea. The company is actively building next-generation digital health infrastructure and AI-driven medical solutions.

berachain.name: Berachain
berachain.description: Berachain is an EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain built on Cosmos SDK and powered by Proof-of-Liquidity consensus. Berachain rearchitects blockchain security and liquidity incentives, creating a capital-efficient network for decentralized finance applications.

oneplanet.name: OnePlanet
oneplanet.description: OnePlanet is an NFT marketplace and Web3 launchpad originally built on Terra and now operating on Polygon, connecting top-tier Web3 games and IP collections.

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.description: Bastion is an enterprise-grade digital asset infrastructure and custody platform built for Web2 and Web3 enterprises. Bastion offers seamless wallet-as-a-service, compliance frameworks, and API integrations for non-custodial user onboarding.

stockal.name: Stockal
stockal.description: Stockal is a global investment platform enabling international users to invest in US equities, ETFs, and digital asset products seamlessly.

hashport.name: HashPort
hashport.description: HashPort is an enterprise-grade cross-chain bridge and interoperability portal connecting Hedera, Ethereum, Polygon, and major Web3 networks.

union.name: Union
union.description: Union is a hyper-efficient zero-knowledge interoperability Layer 1 protocol engineered for trustless cross-chain message passing and asset transfers across modular ecosystems. Utilizing advanced ZK-SNARKs and CometBFT consensus, Union connects EVM, Cosmos, and Rollup environments without trusting centralized multisigs or external validator sets. The team values cryptographic innovation, Rust systems development, distributed consensus modeling, and decentralized network architecture. Union utilizes advanced zero-knowledge proofs and CometBFT consensus to enable trustless, hyper-efficient cross-chain message passing and asset transfers across EVM and Cosmos networks. marketnode.name: Marketnode
marketnode.description: Marketnode is a SGX-backed digital markets infrastructure firm built by Singapore Exchange (SGX Group) and Temasek, transforming capital markets through blockchain tokenization and digital asset workflows.

veda.name: Veda
veda.description: Veda, founded in 2024 by Sun Raghupathi and collaborators in New York, builds institutional vault infrastructure for DeFi yield. Its platform, Veda Vaults, abstracts cross-chain staking, restaking and DeFi strategies behind tokenized vaults that handle rebalancing, risk management and accounting for fintechs and asset managers. Designed to let apps offer yield without running keeper infrastructure, Veda integrates with custodians, bridges and protocols while preserving non-custodial controls and audited strategies. Headquartered in New York with a distributed team, Veda operates at the intersection of DeFi and traditional asset management, emphasizing operational safety, liquidity and transparent reporting. Early deployments power vaults across Ethereum and L2s for a growing partner base. Expect a risk-aware, product-focused culture that values DeFi composability, institutional reliability and simplifying yield delivery for builders and allocators.

category-labs.name: Category Labs
category-labs.description: Category Labs, founded in 2022 by a small research collective with hubs in New York and San Francisco and closely associated with Monad ecosystem development, builds foundational research and tooling for high-performance blockchains. Operating as an early contributor group alongside Monad Labs, Category focuses on parallel execution, consensus optimization and formal verification for next-generation EVM networks. Headquartered with a distributed research team, Category contributes open-source libraries, testnet tooling and mechanism studies that inform Monad and broader EVM scaling efforts. The team blends academic research with shipping production chain upgrades. Governed as a builder collective rather than a custodial company, it emphasizes peer review and reproducible benchmarks. Expect a research-intensive culture that values distributed systems rigor, measured performance and collaborative advancement of scalable EVM infrastructure.

serotonin.name: Serotonin
serotonin.description: Serotonin, founded in 2020 by Amanda Cassatt, former Consensys CMO, in New York with hubs in London, operates as a leading Web3 marketing, communications and product studio. Its practice spans brand strategy, content, community and go-to-market for protocols, L2s and consumer apps, plus product ventures and events. Headquartered in New York and London with a distributed team, Serotonin combines agency services with builder perspective, helping teams navigate token launches, rebrands and ecosystem growth. Known for clear storytelling and design polish, it serves foundations and startups seeking credible narrative and distribution in noisy markets. The studio emphasizes research-driven messaging and long-term brand building over short-term hype. Expect a creative, highly collaborative culture that values editorial craft, strategic thinking and helping ambitious teams communicate complex infrastructure simply and credibly.

squads.name: Squads
squads.description: Squads is the leading smart account and multisig infrastructure on Solana, securing over $10B in assets across major protocols, venture funds, and Web3 enterprises. Through Squads Protocol and Squads Pro, teams manage multisig treasuries, program upgrades, validator staking, and automated permissions with institutional security. Squads is formally verified and trusted as the security standard across the Solana ecosystem. The engineering culture values formal verification, Rust security, and rock-solid UI design. m0.name: M0
m0.description: M0, founded in 2023 by Luca Prosperi, Gregory Di Prisco and Oliver Schimek with headquarters in Zug, Switzerland, builds decentralized infrastructure for issuing custom stablecoins. Its protocol provides a federated layer where approved minters collateralize and issue M tokens backed by short-term Treasuries, with governance over collateral and rate parameters. Headquartered in Zug with distributed contributors across the US and Europe, M0 targets fintechs, funds and protocols that want branded dollar liabilities without building issuance from scratch. The design separates Minting, Collateral and Governance, emphasizing transparency, daily attestation and composability with DeFi. Still scaling mainnet adoption and partner integrations, it focuses on open, extensible money. Backed by Pantera Capital and Ribbit Capital, it operates as neutral plumbing. Expect a research and mechanism-design culture that values risk rigor, governance thoughtfulness and enabling diverse stablecoin builders.

anza.name: Anza
anza.description: Anza, founded in 2024 as an independent spinout from Solana Labs by former core engineers in San Francisco, stewards core Solana protocol development including the Agave validator client. Formed to decentralize client development alongside Firedancer and Jito, Anza focuses on networking, runtime, consensus and performance improvements for the Solana network. Headquartered in San Francisco with a distributed engineering team, the firm was created with backing from Solana ecosystem stakeholders to ensure long-term protocol resilience and client diversity. Its work includes feature activation, testing and validator tooling used by the global validator set running mainnet. Operating as a research and engineering lab, Anza contributes open-source upgrades and performance research. Expect a low-level systems culture that prizes protocol correctness, validator empathy and shipping careful, high-impact changes for a live high-throughput network.

somnia.name: Somnia
somnia.description: Somnia, initiated by the Virtual Society Foundation (VSF) in 2024, develops a high-performance, EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain capable of processing over 400,000 transactions per second with sub-second finality. Engineered specifically for mass-consumer applications, gaming, social protocols and interconnected metaverses, Somnia introduces proprietary IceDB database architecture and advanced compiler optimizations that eliminate traditional EVM execution bottlenecks while retaining standard Solidity developer tooling. Governed by VSF and distributed globally, Somnia focuses on open-source protocol research, throughput benchmarking and empowering creators to deploy rich, real-time interactive virtual worlds on-chain. Somnia's proprietary IceDB database and EVM compiler optimizations enable massive throughput scalability, processing over 400,000 transactions per second for real-time metaverse and gaming applications.

molecule.name: Molecule
molecule.description: Molecule is a decentralized science (DeSci) platform pioneering IP-NFTs and biotech funding protocols to accelerate early-stage scientific research. Molecule connects academic researchers with decentralized collector collectives (BioDAOs) to fund drug discovery, longevity research, and rare disease therapeutics on-chain. Molecule's DeSci platform connects academic researchers with BioDAOs, using IP-NFTs and smart contract funding protocols to finance early-stage biotech and longevity research. Molecule empowers scientific collectives to fund drug discovery, host intellectual property on-chain, and decentralize biomedical research and development. Molecule's DeSci platform connects academic researchers with BioDAOs, using IP-NFTs and smart contract funding protocols to finance early-stage biotech and longevity research.

sei.name: Sei
sei.description: Sei, developed by Sei Labs founded in 2021 by Jeffrey Feng and Jayendra Jog with hubs in New York and San Francisco, is a layer-1 blockchain purpose-built for high-performance trading. Its architecture features Twin-Turbo consensus, parallelization and a native order-matching engine that deliver low latency and high throughput for perpetuals, orderbooks and gaming. Sei migrated from Cosmos SDK to an EVM-compatible design to preserve tooling while retaining trading optimizations, supporting USDC rails and indexer infrastructure for builders. Headquartered across the US with a global validator set, Sei funds ecosystem grants and trading-focused dApps. Backed by Multicoin and Coinbase Ventures, it targets exchange-grade performance on-chain. Expect a performance-driven culture that values market-structure understanding, low-latency engineering and helping trading teams build responsive, scalable venues without compromising decentralization.

newton.name: Newton
newton.description: Newton Protocol, developed by Magic Labs founded in 2018 by Sean Li and Jaemin Jin in San Francisco with the Magic Newton Foundation established in October 2024, builds verifiable automation infrastructure for AI agents and on-chain actions. Its core protocol combines trusted execution environments with zero-knowledge proofs to let agents execute cross-chain intents, rebalancing and DeFi workflows under user-defined zkPermissions with spending limits and allowlists. Designed for chain abstraction, Newton abstracts gas and signing while enforcing transparent constraints auditable on-chain. Headquartered in San Francisco with a foundation presence in the Cayman Islands and a distributed research team, Newton operates at the intersection of AI, cryptography and decentralized finance through partner integrations with wallets and rollups. Expect a research-heavy culture that values protocol correctness, thoughtful agent design and shipping reliable automation for everyday crypto users.

renegade.name: Renegade
renegade.description: Renegade, founded in 2022 by Chris Bender and Joey Kraut in San Francisco, builds an on-chain dark pool for anonymous crypto trading. Its flagship venue, Renegade Dark Pool, uses multiparty computation and zero-knowledge proofs to match orders without revealing size or direction pre-trade, settling directly on-chain with self-custody on Arbitrum and Base. merkle-trade.name: Merkle Trade
merkle-trade.description: Merkle Trade is a decentralized gamified perpetual exchange built on Aptos, offering high-leverage crypto and forex trading with low latency and deep liquidity.

subzero-labs.name: Subzero Labs
subzero-labs.description: Subzero Labs ($20M Seed Raise led by Pantera Capital & Coinbase Ventures) is the core team behind Rialo, the Real World Blockchain for Global Neo Finance. Subzero Labs brings decentralized technology to where users and financial institutions operate by uniting on-chain programmability with real-world financial infrastructure. Founded by leaders and researchers from Meta, Netflix, Google, Apple, Amazon, Mysten Labs, Diem, CME Group, and Kraken, Subzero Labs builds high-performance, event-driven blockchain platforms for enterprise and developer adoption.

taiko-labs.name: Taiko Labs
taiko-labs.description: Taiko Labs is building Taiko, a fully decentralized, Ethereum-equivalent ZK-Rollup (Type 1 ZK-EVM) designed to scale Ethereum without technical or security compromises.

mythical-games.name: Mythical Games
mythical-games.description: Mythical Games is a Web3 gaming studio and marketplace platform behind hit titles like NFL Rivals and Blankos Block Party, powered by the Mythos Layer 1 blockchain.

dfns.name: Dfns
dfns.description: Dfns is a cybersecurity and wallet-as-a-service (WaaS) infrastructure provider powered by MPC (Multi-Party Computation). Dfns enables fintechs, banks, and Web3 apps to embed programmatic non-custodial crypto wallets directly into their applications.

frontrun.name: Frontrun
frontrun.description: Frontrun is a specialized high-frequency trading firm and quantitative market maker operating across centralized and decentralized digital asset venues.

story-protocol.name: Story Protocol
story-protocol.description: Story Protocol, built by PIP Labs and backed by a16z crypto, is the programmable intellectual property Layer 1 blockchain engineered to tokenize, protect, and monetize creative IP in the age of generative AI. By turning creative assets, models, and characters into on-chain IP Legos with embedded licensing, remix rules, and automated revenue splits, Story provides creators with enforceable digital rights. The team values cryptographic IP modeling, high-throughput blockchain architecture, intuitive developer SDKs, and creator economy tools. Story Protocol tokenizes creative intellectual property on-chain, allowing creators to embed automated licensing, remix rules, and royalty splits into digital assets using programmable IP Legos.

xt-com-exchange.name: XT.com Exchange
xt-com-exchange.description: XT.com is a socialized digital asset trading platform serving 6M+ registered users with spot, futures, interest staking, and OTC trading.

trojan.name: Trojan
trojan.description: Trojan is a leading high-speed automated trading terminal and decentralized bot platform on Solana, processing billions in monthly transaction volume. Offering instant swaps, copy trading, automated DCA, limit orders, anti-MEV protection, and multi-wallet management, Trojan gives retail traders professional execution speeds directly inside chat and web interfaces. The team prioritizes ultra-low latency transaction routing, Solana RPC infrastructure, and scalable distributed backends. Trojan delivers high-speed automated trading, copy trading, and MEV protection on Solana, processing billions in monthly volume for retail and professional traders. world-foundation.name: World Foundation
world-foundation.description: World Foundation, established in 2023 to steward World (formerly Worldcoin) alongside Tools for Humanity, oversees World ID, World Chain and community governance for proof-of-personhood. The Foundation, headquartered in the Cayman Islands with contributors across San Francisco and Berlin, administers grants, orb operator programs and ecosystem incentives independent of Tools for Humanity's hardware and app development. Its mission centers on providing verifiable human identity via the Orb while preserving privacy through zero-knowledge proofs and open research. The Foundation coordinates open development, privacy reviews and global distribution logistics. Backed by ecosystem endowment, it focuses on inclusive access and decentralization over commercial product. The Foundation stewards orb manufacturing, operator incentives and open privacy research that ensure distribution scales without centralizing biometric control. Expect a mission-driven culture that values privacy engineering, thoughtful rollout and building credible neutral infrastructure for human verification.

astar-foundation.name: Astar Foundation
astar-foundation.description: Astar Foundation is the core organization behind Astar Network, Japan’s prominent Layer 1 and Layer 2 blockchain ecosystem. Supporting both EVM and WebAssembly (Wasm) smart contracts, Astar connects polkadot and Ethereum ecosystems while driving Web3 adoption among major global enterprises.

0x.name: 0x
0x.description: 0x, founded in 2017 by Will Warren and Amir Bandeali in San Francisco, develops open exchange infrastructure for Ethereum and EVM chains. Its product suite includes 0x Protocol for order settlement, 0x API and Tx Relay for aggregated swap routing and gasless execution, and on-chain RFQ via Periscope that power wallets like Coinbase Wallet, Robinhood Wallet and Matcha. Headquartered in San Francisco with a distributed team, 0x abstracts liquidity across decentralized exchanges behind a single API that handles routing, slippage and MEV protection for developers. Audited and governed as open infrastructure, 0x emphasizes performance, reliability and economic efficiency. Expect an engineering-driven culture that values routing correctness, developer experience and building invisible exchange rails that make trading feel simple and fair.

apex-protocol.name: ApeX Protocol
apex-protocol.description: Apex Protocol, founded in 2022 by a decentralized collective of derivatives traders and engineers, is a leading multi-chain decentralized perpetual exchange. Powered by StarkWare's StarkEx engine and ZK-rollup scaling, ApeX Pro provides orderbook-style perpetual futures trading with zero gas fees, low slippage, deep cross-margin liquidity and self-custodial asset control. Headquartered as a distributed remote organization with hubs in Dubai and Singapore, ApeX is governed by APEX token holders and supports diverse EVM and non-EVM settlement layers. The team focuses on quantitative trading architecture, latency reduction and delivering a CEX-competitive trading experience with trustless DEX security. ApeX Pro utilizes ZK-rollup scaling to deliver zero-gas orderbook perpetual futures trading with deep cross-margin liquidity and self-custodial asset control.

puffer-finance.name: Puffer Finance
puffer-finance.description: Puffer Finance is a decentralized liquid restaking protocol (LRP) built on EigenLayer, lowering barriers for Ethereum node operators and boosting staking rewards.

bitway.name: Bitway
bitway.description: Bitway is a digital asset payment gateway and financial technology provider enabling merchants and enterprises to accept, settlement, and manage cryptocurrency transactions globally with zero volatility risk.

mercari.name: Mercari
mercari.description: Mercari is a Japanese e-commerce titan operating Mercari Crypto, allowing millions of users to buy, sell, and trade Bitcoin and digital assets directly inside the Mercari app.

jupiter.name: Jupiter
jupiter.description: Jupiter is the core liquidity routing engine and premier trading hub on the Solana blockchain, processing the vast majority of Solana DEX volume. Founded by Meow, Jupiter offers spot swap aggregation, perpetual futures trading, dollar-cost averaging (DCA), limit orders, bridge routing, and the active JUP DAO community ecosystem. Known for its catdet community ethos and relentless product cadence, Jupiter focuses on delivering the best pricing, zero-slippage routing, and top-tier user experience in decentralized finance. Jupiter routes the vast majority of Solana DEX trading volume, delivering optimal price execution, perpetual trading, DCA tools, and JUP DAO community governance. quicknode.name: QuickNode
quicknode.description: QuickNode is a premier blockchain infrastructure and node API provider delivering fast, reliable RPC access, dedicated nodes, and developer tooling across more than 40 blockchain networks. Powering thousands of Web3 applications, exchanges, and institutions, QuickNode ensures high-availability global endpoints and real-time on-chain data streaming for decentralized finance and digital asset developers worldwide.

zama.name: Zama
zama.description: Zama, founded in 2020 by Rand Hindi and Pascal Paillier in Paris, creates confidential computing infrastructure using fully homomorphic encryption for blockchain and AI. Its products include the fhEVM for encrypted smart contracts on EVM chains, Concrete ML for privacy-preserving machine learning, and TFHE-rs libraries that let developers compute on encrypted data without decrypting. Headquartered in Paris with hubs in London and New York, Zama enables DeFi, identity and auction use cases where data remains encrypted during execution with selective disclosure. The team advances open-source cryptography and hardware acceleration for practical performance. Backed by leading investors, Zama bridges deep cryptography and product engineering. Expect a research-intensive culture that values cryptographic rigor, careful benchmarking and making privacy primitives usable for everyday developers and institutions.

nansen.name: Nansen
nansen.description: Nansen, founded in 2020 by Alex Svanevik, Lars Bakke Krogvig and Evgeny Medvedev in Singapore, provides on-chain analytics that labels wallets, tracks smart money and decodes DeFi activity across 20+ chains. Its platform combines address clustering, portfolio analytics and alerts that help investors, teams and compliance professionals understand flows behind tokens, NFTs and governance. Headquartered in Singapore with hubs in London and remote globally, Nansen is known for curated dashboards, research reports and wallet profiling that surfaces entity behavior without relying on off-chain disclosure. The company emphasizes labeling accuracy and user-friendly data visualization. Backed by leading investors, it serves a broad base of researchers and institutions. Expect a data and research-driven culture focused on labeling quality, investigative rigor and turning complex on-chain behavior into actionable insight.

dcg.name: DCG
dcg.description: Digital Currency Group (DCG), founded in 2015 by Barry Silbert in Stamford, Connecticut and New York, is a diversified holding company and investor in digital assets. Its portfolio includes Grayscale, the largest digital asset manager, CoinDesk media, Foundry mining and advisory services, plus investments in hundreds of early-stage crypto companies. Headquartered in Stamford with a major presence in New York, DCG provides capital, governance and operational support for subsidiaries operating as independent brands. The firm pioneered regulated wrappers for crypto exposure and mining infrastructure in North America. Unlike a single-product startup, DCG functions as an ecosystem builder spanning media, mining and asset management. Expect a diversified, operational culture that values long-term company building, risk oversight and supporting founders navigating regulated crypto markets.

zerion.name: Zerion
zerion.description: Zerion, founded in 2019 by Evgeny Yurtaev, Vadim Koleoshkin and Alexey Bashlykov in San Francisco, builds a leading Web3 wallet and portfolio platform. Originating from early work in 2016 and formally launched as Zerion, its products include Zerion Wallet, a self-custody multichain wallet with transaction simulation and phishing protection, plus portfolio tracking that aggregates tokens, NFTs and DeFi positions across 10+ chains. Designed to hide chain complexity behind clear pricing, bridging and swap aggregation, Zerion serves millions of users who manage assets without juggling multiple explorers. The platform supports hardware wallet integration and social graph features. Headquartered in San Francisco with a distributed team including London, Zerion is backed by Mosaic and Wintermute Ventures. Expect a product-driven culture that prizes usability, security mindfulness and helping newcomers navigate multichain finance confidently.

p2p-org.name: P2P.org
p2p-org.description: P2P.org, founded in 2018 by a team of validators and staking researchers with headquarters in the Cayman Islands and operations in Lisbon and Dubai, provides non-custodial staking infrastructure for institutions. Its platform supports dedicated validators, restaking and yield products across Ethereum, Cosmos, Solana and 30+ networks, handling key management, monitoring and performance reporting without taking custody. Serving exchanges, custodians and funds staking significant assets, P2P.org emphasizes uptime, slashing protection and transparent rewards distribution. Headquartered with a distributed global team, the firm operates bare-metal and cloud validators with SOC-audited processes. The team blends protocol research with 24/7 operations. The platform provides dashboards, alerting and governance participation services that simplify operations for funds staking significant assets across diverse networks. Expect an operations-focused culture that values validator reliability, security discipline and helping institutions earn sustainable staking yield with institutional controls.

jito-labs.name: Jito Labs
jito-labs.description: Jito Labs (Jito Network) is the leading liquid staking and MEV (Maximal Extractable Value) infrastructure provider on Solana, maintaining JitoSOL and high-performance validator execution clients.

raydium.name: Raydium
raydium.description: Raydium is an automated market maker (AMM) and foundational liquidity protocol built on the Solana blockchain. Providing standard AMM pools, concentrated liquidity market maker (CLMM) positions, and automated routing, Raydium serves as a primary liquidity hub for Solana DeFi tokens, meme coins, and ecosystem launches. Its high-throughput smart contracts take full advantage of Solana speed and low transaction fees. The team prioritizes AMM mathematical efficiency, Solana program development in Rust, and intuitive trading UI design. Raydium provides high-throughput AMM liquidity pools and concentrated market maker positions on Solana, taking full advantage of low fees and sub-second execution. chronicle-labs.name: Chronicle Labs
chronicle-labs.description: Chronicle Labs, founded in 2023 by Niklas Kunkel in Zug, Switzerland, develops Chronicle Protocol, the original decentralized oracle that has secured the MakerDAO and Sky ecosystem since 2017. Chronicle delivers cost-effective, verifiable real-world and market data feeds to EVM chains using innovative Schnorr-based threshold cryptography (Scribe) that reduces gas consumption by up to 60% compared to legacy oracles. Headquartered in Zug with distributed cryptography researchers across Europe and North America, Chronicle emphasizes open accessibility, on-chain verifiability and robust multi-sig security for mission-critical DeFi protocols. Chronicle Protocol delivers cost-effective, verifiable oracle price feeds to EVM chains using Schnorr-based threshold cryptography, securing MakerDAO and Sky ecosystem assets.

tenderly.name: Tenderly
tenderly.description: Tenderly is an all-in-one Web3 development and observability platform used by over 300,000 blockchain developers and top DeFi protocols. Tenderly provides real-time smart contract monitoring, zero-latency node infrastructure, transaction simulation, visual debugger, and automated alerting across 30+ EVM networks. Backed by Accel and Spark Capital, Tenderly eliminates guesswork in smart contract development and incident response. validation-cloud.name: Validation Cloud
validation-cloud.description: Validation Cloud, founded in 2017 by Alex Nwaka and Andrew McFarlane and headquartered in Zug, Switzerland with significant operations in Houston, offers institutional staking, node and data infrastructure across 30+ chains. Its platform provides validators, archival nodes, staking dashboards and SOC-compliant APIs used by exchanges, custodians and enterprises to access Ethereum, Solana, Polygon and Cosmos without operating infrastructure directly. Headquartered at Dammstrasse 16, Zug with a globally distributed ops team spanning Europe and North America, Validation Cloud emphasizes uptime, hardware security modules and transparent reporting for staked assets. Serving institutions staking significant value, it blends data center operations with protocol research and enterprise support. Expect a reliability-driven culture focused on node performance, security auditing and enabling institutions to participate in proof-of-stake networks with managed controls.

skyrise.name: Skyrise
skyrise.description: Skyrise is a Web3 growth, attribution, and on-chain user engagement platform that helps decentralized applications identify, acquire, and retain real active users. Combining blockchain wallet analytics with targeted questing, rewards distribution, and conversion tracking, Skyrise enables protocols to build sustainable community growth without bot spam. The team blends growth marketing psychology, full-stack web engineering, and on-chain data indexing. lido.name: Lido
lido.description: Lido, launched in December 2020 by Konstantin Lomashuk, Vasiliy Shapovalov and Jordan Fish and governed by Lido DAO, operates the leading liquid staking protocol for Ethereum and other networks. Its design lets users stake ETH via curated validators and receive stETH, a liquid token usable across DeFi while accruing validation rewards, preserving decentralization and liquidity. Audited and non-custodial, Lido supports distributed validator technology and dual governance research to limit operator risk. Governed by LDO holders with contributors across Europe and globally remote, Lido serves millions and secures significant staked value across the ecosystem. Backed by DAO treasury and investors including Semantic VC and ParaFi Capital, the protocol emphasizes transparency and security. Expect a governance-driven culture that values open collaboration, rigorous risk analysis and steadily improving decentralized staking infrastructure for the ecosystem.

cryptio.name: Cryptio
cryptio.description: Cryptio, founded in 2018 by Antoine Scalia and team in Paris, develops institutional crypto accounting, reporting and audit platforms for enterprises. Its products ingest transactions from chains, exchanges and custodians to automate subledger, reconciliation, cost-basis and financial reporting that satisfies CFO and auditor requirements. Used by funds, corporates and DAOs managing treasury across Ethereum and L2s, Cryptio integrates with ERP systems, custodians and explorers to produce audit-ready books. Headquartered in Paris with hubs in New York and London, Cryptio bridges finance operations and on-chain data. Backed by leading investors, it emphasizes data accuracy and compliance. Its integrations with custodians, ERP systems and explorers automate subledger entries, reconciliation and audit packets that reduce close cycles for finance teams. Expect a finance and data-focused culture that values accounting precision, product reliability and helping institutions close books on digital assets confidently.

nethermind.name: Nethermind
nethermind.description: Nethermind, founded in 2017 by Tomasz Stanczak and Demetrios Skalkotos in London, builds Ethereum execution client infrastructure and broader protocol tooling. Its flagship Nethermind client, written in .NET, runs significant share of Ethereum nodes, supporting staking, syncing and validator operations alongside contributions to research, formal verification and developer libraries like Warp for Starknet. Beyond the client, Nethermind provides audits, MEV research and data services used by foundations and enterprises deploying Ethereum infrastructure globally. Headquartered in London with teams across the UK, Poland and globally remote, Nethermind is backed by ecosystem grants and service revenue. The team champions client diversity for network resilience and decentralization. Expect an engineering-focused culture that values open-source stewardship, low-level systems craft and meticulous reliability for production Ethereum nodes.

across-protocol.name: Across Protocol
across-protocol.description: Across Protocol, developed since 2021 by Risk Labs (the team behind UMA Protocol) led by Hart Lambur and Allison Lu in New York, is one of Web3's fastest and most capital-efficient cross-chain intent bridges. Powered by an optimistic oracle verification mechanism and a network of competitive market makers (relayers), Across executes asset transfers across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base and Polygon in seconds with low fees and minimal slippage. Governed via the ACX token and audited by leading security firms, Across emphasizes mechanism design efficiency, oracle correctness and seamless omnichain liquidity settlement. Across Protocol provides intent-based cross-chain bridging across EVM Layer 2s, utilizing optimistic verification and relayer networks for sub-minute asset transfers.

aztec-labs.name: Aztec Labs
aztec-labs.description: Aztec Labs is building Aztec, a privacy-first Layer 2 zkRollup on Ethereum, enabling encrypted smart contracts and private programmable state using zero-knowledge cryptography.

immunefi.name: Immunefi
immunefi.description: Immunefi, founded in 2020 by Mitchell Amador, Travin Keith and Duncan Townsend with hubs in Singapore and Lisbon, runs the largest Web3 bug bounty and audit competition platform. Its protocol hosts bounties for 300+ projects including Chainlink, Optimism and Arbitrum, coordinating disclosure, triage and payouts that have prevented significant potential losses. The platform also offers audit competitions via Magnus and attackathon programs for foundations. Headquartered with a distributed team, Immunefi provides vaults for bounty funding, analyst review and researcher reputation rather than direct custody. Backed by leading investors, it sits at the nexus of security and ecosystem resilience. Its vault and triage systems coordinate disclosure timelines, researcher reputation and enterprise reporting that strengthen ecosystem resilience beyond individual bug fixes. Expect a security-first culture that values responsible disclosure, researcher relationships and raising the baseline for smart contract safety across the industry.

21shares.name: 21Shares
21shares.description: 21Shares, founded in 2018 by Hany Rashwan, Ophelia Snyder and team in Zug, Switzerland, is a leading issuer of crypto exchange-traded products and ETFs. Its platform lists physically-backed ETPs for Bitcoin, Ethereum and thematic baskets on major European exchanges and US markets via partnerships, handling creation, custody and index methodology for institutions and retail. Headquartered in Zug with offices in New York, London and Dubai, 21Shares navigates diverse regulatory regimes under traditional market oversight with SOC-audited operations. The firm pioneered accessible wrappers for crypto exposure before spot ETF approvals. Backed by leading investors, it emphasizes disclosure and market education. Expect a market- and compliance-driven culture that values ETP operations precision, regulated product craft and expanding responsible investment access to digital assets.

filecoin-foundation.name: Filecoin Foundation
filecoin-foundation.description: Filecoin Foundation, established in 2021 as the independent steward of the Filecoin network originally created by Protocol Labs in 2014, supports decentralized storage and the InterPlanetary File System ecosystem. The Foundation, headquartered in the United States with a globally distributed team, administers grants, governance facilitation, research and education that advance open, verifiable storage for digital preservation, AI datasets and Web3 archiving. Filecoin itself offers verifiable storage deals and data availability secured by proof-of-replication. The Foundation coordinates upgrades, community events and public goods funding independent of Protocol Labs' engineering. Backed by ecosystem contributions, it emphasizes long-term data persistence. The Foundation funds accelerator programs, storage audits and governance tooling that help storage providers maintain verifiable deals and long-term preservation guarantees. Expect a nonprofit, ecosystem-driven culture centered on storage reliability, open development and expanding practical decentralized infrastructure for data-intensive builders worldwide.

very-ai.name: Very AI
very-ai.description: Very AI is an intelligent Web3 automation platform combining decentralized compute, artificial intelligence agents, and blockchain rails to automate complex on-chain workflows. By bridging large language models with smart contract execution environments, Very AI enables autonomous agents to perform trading, portfolio management, and protocol governance interactions. The company prizes machine learning engineering, crypto-economic incentive design, and user-centric automation. Very AI combines decentralized compute with AI agent frameworks, enabling autonomous agents to execute complex smart contract workflows, trading, and governance tasks. zetachain.name: ZetaChain
zetachain.description: ZetaChain, founded in 2021 by Ankur Nandwani, Panruo Wu and team with hubs in San Francisco and globally distributed, develops an omnichain Layer 1 for native cross-chain smart contracts. Its protocol enables EVM contracts that control assets and data on Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and other chains via a single account and cross-chain messaging without wrapped intermediaries, using threshold signature validators. Developers use ZetaChain to build omnichain DeFi, identity and gaming apps that aggregate liquidity. Headquartered with a distributed team, ZetaChain emphasizes chain-agnostic UX, security auditing and ecosystem grants for omnichain builders. Backed by leading investors, the project is progressing through mainnet and partner integrations. Expect a builder-focused culture that values interoperability research, protocol correctness and helping teams ship seamless cross-chain experiences without bridging fragmentation.

pyth-network.name: Pyth Network
pyth-network.description: Pyth Network, incubated in 2021 within Jump Crypto with leadership from Michael Cahill and a team of market data specialists with hubs in San Francisco and New York, provides high-frequency oracle infrastructure for DeFi. Its design aggregates first-party pricing from trading firms and exchanges that publish directly on-chain, delivering low-latency feeds for equities, FX, crypto and commodities across 80+ chains via pull oracles and Hermes. Developers use Pyth for perpetuals, lending and risk pricing that requires sub-second updates and confidence intervals. Headquartered with a distributed contributor set, Pyth is governed as open infrastructure with broad publisher participation. Expect a data and markets-focused culture that values feed accuracy, latency engineering and enabling DeFi protocols to price risk reliably at real-market speed.

paribu.name: Paribu
paribu.description: Paribu, founded in 2017 by Yasin Oral in Istanbul, is Turkey's leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 6 million registered users with spot trading, local Turkish Lira (TRY) banking integrations and enterprise custody. Licensed and compliant with Turkish regulatory frameworks, Paribu processes significant daily trading volume across hundreds of crypto pairs and operates Paribu Ventures and Paribu Cineverse cultural initiatives. Headquartered in Istanbul, Paribu combines high-throughput matching engines with round-the-clock Turkish language customer support and local bank settlement. The culture focuses on trust, national fintech leadership and building accessible digital asset infrastructure for Turkish investors. Paribu serves over 6 million Turkish users with compliant spot crypto trading, Turkish Lira bank rails, enterprise custody, and digital asset education initiatives.

horizon.name: Horizon
horizon.description: Horizon Blockchain Games is the creator of Sequence—the leading smart wallet and developer platform for Web3 games—and Skyweaver, an acclaimed digital trading card game. Horizon provides game studios with turn-key account abstraction, invisible wallet onboarding, and full-stack game infrastructure. Horizon Blockchain Games builds Sequence smart wallet APIs and Skyweaver trading card games, providing game studios with full-stack Web3 account abstraction tooling. Sequence enables web3 game developers to offer invisible wallet creation, gasless transactions, and seamless NFT marketplace integration to mainstream players. eclipse.name: Eclipse
eclipse.description: Eclipse, founded in 2022 by Neel Somani and Vijay Chetty and headquartered in San Francisco, is Ethereum's first Layer 2 powered by the Solana Virtual Machine (SVM). Eclipse combines the high-throughput execution speed and parallel processing of Solana with the deep liquidity, settlement security and decentralization of Ethereum, using Celestia for modular data availability and RISC Zero for ZK fraud proofs. Backed by Tribe Capital, Hack VC and Polychain, Eclipse provides developers with sub-second finality and micro-cent transaction fees for consumer dApps and DeFi. The team values systems performance, distributed architecture and bridges the best of the Ethereum and Solana ecosystems.

ledger.name: Ledger
ledger.description: Ledger, founded in 2014 by Eric Larcheveque, Joel Pobeda, Nicolas Bacca and Thomas France in Paris, develops hardware wallets and enterprise custody for digital assets. Its flagship devices, Ledger Nano S Plus, X and Stax, plus Ledger Live companion, let consumers and institutions secure private keys in secure element chips with offline signing, transaction simulation and Ledger Recover options. Headquartered in Paris with hubs in New York, Portland and London, Ledger manufactures tamper-resistant hardware and certifies firmware via independent audits and open review. Serving millions of customers and enterprises, Ledger emphasizes self-custody, supply-chain security and user education. Expect a security and hardware-focused culture that prizes secure element engineering, meticulous product testing and empowering individuals to own their crypto with audited, physical-grade protection.

gensyn.name: Gensyn
gensyn.description: Gensyn is a decentralized machine learning compute protocol connecting hardware providers with AI developers to train large-scale neural networks at a fraction of centralized cloud costs. Utilizing cryptographic verification, probabilistic proof-of-learning, and graph-based distributed training, Gensyn solves the verification bottleneck of untrusted compute clusters. Backed by a16z and CoinFund, the team combines deep machine learning systems engineering, applied cryptography, distributed computing, and crypto-economic incentives. polychain-capital.name: Polychain Capital
polychain-capital.description: Polychain Capital, founded in 2016 by Olaf Carlson-Wee, the first employee at Coinbase, in San Francisco, operates as a leading crypto hedge fund and venture investor across liquid tokens and early-stage equity. The firm manages diversified strategies including hedge, venture and public fund vehicles that back infrastructure, DeFi and AI companies from seed through public markets. Headquartered in San Francisco with hubs in New York, Polychain is known for long-term thesis-driven investing and holding positions through cycles with research depth. The partnership combines trading, cryptography and protocol research expertise. Backed by its own fund structure, Polychain participates in governance and ecosystem building hands-on. Expect an investment and research-driven culture that values conviction, analytical rigor and partnering closely with founders tackling foundational Web3 problems.
